## Join Gabe and the Campaign on Saturday to Parade and Canvass in La Salle
**___________________________________________________________________________**
Friend and Supporter,
Thanks to all of you that hit the pavement and joined phone banks over the week. Tomorrow the campaign will be participating in the La Salle parade before canvassing doors in the area.

Please check below for location and meeting times.
******___________________________________________________________________________**

**_LaSalle Parade
_****
When:** Saturday July 20th at 10:00am
Please arrive early to park, get your t-shirt or help with the campaign float.

**Where** : Parade Lineup is at Elm St. and Taylor. Ave.

**_Door-Door Canvassing_**
After the parade, we'll take a break and then begin canvassing neighborhoods in La Salle.

* Training, literature and talking are points provided on site.

* If this is your first time to knock doors, please ensure you have been set up on the Walk App (i360). For help getting onboarded, please contact Jessica at [Jessica@ElectGabeEvans.com](mailto:Jessica@ElectGabeEvans.com) or [(720) 691-0565](tel:\(720\) 691-0565).
_
**_What do I need for canvassing?_**__**
**__****_1.) Download the free i360 Walk App from your Apple or Android App Store.

2.) Click [HERE](https://wayrap.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjYwMjExMCxcImxcIjoxMjczMzIzODcyNzYxOTUxODIsXCJyXCI6MTI3MzMyMzg5MTQzNzA5MjQ4fSIsInMiOiI0MmYzYWJmY2MzYjE2ZWQ4In0) for a quick i360 Walk App tutorial.

3.) If you log on, and there is no walk list, we will assign your list when you arrive or if you are working independent from Saturdays, just reach out and we'll ensure you have lists and a survey script.
_**___________________________________________________________________________**
__
_ Hope to see you tomorrow!

He can be appointed and confirmed through the default method prescribed in the Appointments Clause, as Congress has directed for United States Attorneys throughout American history ... or Congress can authorize his appointment through enactment of positive statutory law consistent with the Appointments Clause. We have several Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuits related to the prosecutorial abuses targeting Trump In February 2024, the U.S. Department of Justice asked [] a federal court to allow the agency to keep secret the names of top staffers working in Jack Smith’s office targeting Trump and other Americans. JUDICIAL WATCH ASKS COURT TO RETAIN LAWSUIT TO CLEAN UP VOTER ROLLS IN ILLINOIS Illinois is fighting a federal law requiring it to clean up its voter rolls. We asked [] a federal court to reject the state’s motion to dismiss and end our National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) lawsuit [] to clean up the state’s voting rolls (Judicial Watch, Inc. et al v. The Illinois State Board of Elections et al. [] (No. 1:24-cv-01867)). We sued in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois, Eastern Division, on behalf of the nonprofit organizations Illinois Family Action [], Breakthrough Ideas [], and Carol J. Davis, who is a lawfully registered voter in Illinois. In our original complaint [], we point out that 23 Illinois counties, with a combined registration list of 980,089 voters, reported removing a combined total of only 100 registrations in the last two-year reporting period under a crucial provision of the NVRA. This is an “absurdly small” number, and there “is no possible way these counties can be conducting a general program that makes reasonable effort to cancel registrations of voters who have become ineligible because of a change of residence while removing so few registrations.” We point out: Aside from the outright failure of 23 Illinois counties to remove registrants who fail to respond to Confirmation Notices [as required by NVRA], the complaint also listed counties who lack data that is crucial to list maintenance efforts under the NVRA. Again relying on Defendants’ own admissions to the EAC [Election Assistance Commission], the complaint notes that 34 counties could only report “Data not available” regarding Confirmation Notice removals, and 19 of these reported the same thing for death removals. In addition, 29 counties reported “Data not available” regarding the number of Confirmation Notices sent, and 22 counties said the same thing about the number of inactive registrations. In all, “[f]ifty-two of 108 Illinois jurisdictions failed to report any data to the EAC in one or more of the crucial data categories identified above.” For her part, Defendant Matthews confirmed that she “does not have access to local election authorities’ list maintenance records.” Apparently, no one in Illinois has access to this data. Our attorneys argue: Defendants have failed to implement the NVRA’s required “general program that makes a reasonable effort” to remove voters who have moved or died; Defendant Matthews, who is Illinois’ chief State election official...has failed in her duty to coordinate state responsibilities under the Act; and * Defendants have failed to retain and provide to Plaintiffs NVRA-related records they are required to provide. The support for these allegations derives primarily from Defendants’ own admissions, in response to a survey conducted every two years by the federal Election Assistance Commission as it prepares a mandatory report to Congress, and in their correspondence with Plaintiffs. Dirty voter rolls can mean dirty elections, and Illinois’ voting rolls are a mess. Rather than trying to shut down our lawsuit, Illinois should take immediate steps to clean its rolls to both prevent fraud and increase voter confidence in the elections. As you know, we are a national leader in voting integrity and voting rights. We assembled a team of highly experienced voting rights attorneys who stopped discriminatory elections in Hawaii, and cleaned up voter rolls in California, Ohio, Indiana, and Kentucky, among other achievements []. Robert Popper, a Judicial Watch senior attorney, leads our election law program. Popper was previously in the Voting Section of the Civil Rights Division of the Justice Department, where he managed voting rights investigations, litigations, consent decrees, and settlements in dozens of states. In May 2024, we sued [] California to force the clean-up of its voter rolls. The lawsuit, filed on behalf of Judicial Watch and the Libertarian Party of California, asks the court to compel California to make “a reasonable effort to remove the registrations of ineligible registrants from the voter rolls” as required by federal law. In December 2023, we sent notice letters [] to election officials in the District of Columbia, California, and Illinois, notifying them of evident violations of the National Voter Registration Act [] (NVRA) of 1993, based on their failure to remove inactive voters from their registration rolls. The letters point out that these jurisdictions publicly reported removing few or no ineligible voter registrations under a key provision of the NVRA. The letters threatened federal lawsuits unless the violations were corrected in a timely fashion. In response to Judicial Watch’s inquiries, Washington, DC, officials admitted that they had not complied with the NVRA, promptly removed 65,544 outdated names from the voting rolls, promised to remove 37,962 more, and designated another 73,522 registrations as “inactive.” NVRA lawsuits subsequently were commenced against California [] and Illinois []. In July 2023 we filed [] an amicus curiae (friend of the court) brief [], supporting the decision [] of the U.S. District Court for the District of Maine, which struck down Maine’s policy restricting the use and distribution of the state’s voter registration list (Public Interest Legal Foundation v. Shenna Bellows [] (No. 23-1361). According to a national study [] conducted by Judicial Watch in 2020, Maine’s statewide registration rate was 101% of eligible voters. In July 2023 we also settled [] a federal election integrity lawsuit on behalf of the Illinois Conservative Union against the state of Illinois, the Illinois State Board of Elections, and its director, which now grants access to the current centralized statewide list of registered voters for the state for the past 15 elections. In April 2023, Pennsylvania settled [] with us and admitted in court filings that it removed 178,258 ineligible registrations in response to communications from Judicial Watch. The settlement commits Pennsylvania and five of its counties to extensive public reporting of statistics regarding their ongoing voter roll clean-up efforts for the next five years. In March 2023, Colorado agreed [] to settle our NVRA lawsuit alleging that Colorado failed to remove ineligible voters from its rolls. The settlement agreement requires Colorado to provide Judicial Watch with the most recent voter roll data for each Colorado county each year for six years. In February 2023, Los Angeles County confirmed [] the removal of 1,207,613 ineligible voters from its rolls since last year, under the terms of a settlement agreement [] in a federal lawsuit [] Judicial Watch filed in 2017. We settled [] a federal election integrity lawsuit against New York City after the city removed 441,083 ineligible names from the voter rolls and promised to take reasonable steps going forward to clean its voter registration lists. Kentucky [] also removed hundreds of thousands of old registrations after it entered into a consent decree to end another Judicial Watch lawsuit. In February 2022, we settled [] a voter roll clean-up lawsuit against North Carolina and two of its counties after North Carolina removed over 430,000 inactive registrations from its voter rolls. The first recent wave of air marshals—45 officers and two supervisors—was dispatched to El Paso and Yuma on October 30, 2022, for 21-day rotations. More were assigned later to other busy locations overrun with migrants. The TSA admits it does not know the operational impacts that the air marshal border deployments had on transportation security. “TSA cannot assure deployments did not impact FAMS’ mission to mitigate potential risks and threats to our Nation’s transportation system,” according to a DHS report [] [ days ago thanks to the Air Marshal National Council’s request to probe the matter. The agency did not bother to establish baseline quantifiable and measurable goals from which it could measure the effectiveness of its primary operations while air marshals were assigned to assist CBP at the southwest border, the 17-page report says. TSA incurred approximately $45 million in travel and payroll costs, but the agency was eventually reimbursed by CBP, which also operates under DHS. Under the agreement with CBP, air marshals played the role of “immigration officers,” to perform the following duties: Escorting migrants from the point of apprehension to processing, between various Border Patrol Sector facilities, or to another entity with jurisdiction over post-processing custody; escorting migrants to and from local health providers and hospitals; conducting searches, including pat downs, and placing or removing handcuffs or restraint devices on migrants in custody before they are transported; securing CBP facilities, including detention cells, and authorizing access to various entry controlled points; escorting migrants between processing checkpoints within the facility; assisting with staffing the unaccompanied female housing facility; observing migrants in holding areas to assess their safety and well-being while awaiting processing or transportation. name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Liberty Under Threat
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1uv5jau0ar984gcdicqf28j6628d19dqac8nk7o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c5hm9pr4c1h2bs)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zqfi20ja2ar5hdltj4e7c4ddu5a7f4s6tlhi0eug_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c5jm4pj6c1h2bs)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zeju5pp0r1n6frc5or2ab469jgkuqjbuq20v5tq0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c5jm4pj6c1h2bs)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zbelluhse73p90qs39m9eg5k9569dglhrjt7v4ug_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c5jm4pj6c1h2bs)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z77ncsn7bp7vo1vk7o1rqlc0e0lku6km57adetco_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c5jm4pj6c1h2bs)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9g0csermjl9b5o91ul414fqocdk5ie8fgfdhqo0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c5jmao30cdh2bs)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zplnljae4n7ntq5jhitl05g3q1tp0ac0bjiql980_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c5jmao30cdh2bs)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zs8t19ge4t6dvrcjj7u0tschugns3bn0f90me6a8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c5jmao30cdh2bs)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zkss6hmgn8ssj3jcomhmkmiurojqotaff5gameqo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c5jmao30cdh2bs)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Elon Musk sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/jW-iKeeKkIy0YlxZCmiFLA~~/AARclAA~/RgRofgh6P0RQaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPUNCNTE4NDJXA3NwY0IKZpj0bptmAhInW1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/jW-iKeeKkIy0YlxZCmiFLA~~/AARclAA~/RgRofgh6P0RQaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPUNCNTE4NDJXA3NwY0IKZpj0bptmAhInW1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---

name: Hillsdale College via Conservatives Give
subject: Liberty Under Threat
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9069479a03fc40aa808943344d3bcf32&_e=FsSyO95MNTrxSwf_Mtv67yXoc6Ae2XpKQ0-d_0Xq00hyWuJLSK3CKa2oyJyozmSsPakarRF0IiD9TkdVX6ZkChH-fD6JUJ9JZKWTPJNfswwwjEPMah8V_eB4Y6a29HpK16TvGcEfN2eCz_nkgNNXNMp1ddP-4fguL2eyv_JfT3ocBCfdEvV1a1QtctCXe4fXiyC-HxZhW88Ox9W7QApUJGTZ654OR7QcwJn7lXVVI5jSsWOe98_ShLFhx-wLtiEFgOJtgYHkv2rIKwzr4-4U-18Dulq3oJmh-uOT4jz3hVs9_cWEXM6BL5rC_DkbEm_ktJed20by-145WLlM98r4cS8wp2Uz91Gmy7y7I-8rUg3uCtZpnvSBkDaCMVjaVE9KXTZzoD37SOQgg0CfQ61SIw%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9069479a03fc40aa808943344d3bcf32&_e=FsSyO95MNTrxSwf_Mtv67yXoc6Ae2XpKQ0-d_0Xq00hyWuJLSK3CKa2oyJyozmSsPakarRF0IiD9TkdVX6ZkChH-fD6JUJ9JZKWTPJNfswwwjEPMah8V_eB4Y6a29HpK16TvGcEfN2eCz_nkgNNXNMp1ddP-4fguL2eyv_JfT3ocBCfdEvV1a1QtctCXe4fXiyC-HxZhW88Ox9W7QApUJGTZ654OR7QcwJn7lXVVI5jSsWOe98_ShLFhx-wLtiEFfmV_XFsOuGWXUj4UtrrEHqVi1XRZ-HlMh3dxPfy0qec5FNLTpEH3eR0WAI0pAxDhX4dKD8YyrltraF4npMld1DIk42GNJTPAN-CwH1OOQqj9NUUTixSmFyKW2LcLDDTtsY9okCkCxnvsqnJ0LmZmzw%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

clean_body: We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America! This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Fellow American, Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear. Together, these forces want to circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity , and push their own false and dishonest narrative about American history and about what's happening today. More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed." We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America! The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities. It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley. We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education. Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem. A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty. Hillsdale launched Imprimis over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective. Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, Imprimis is more critical than ever. Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments. On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is simply and clearly un-American. There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says Imprimis is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month. You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are mailed to homes and businesses ten times per year. Our research also shows that Imprimis subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving Imprimis even greater reach and influence. And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--Imprimis has a greater circulation than the Wall Street Journal and The New York Times --we are determined to do more. Since Imprimis launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription. But the fact that we offer Imprimis free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing Imprimis is without cost. Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of Imprimis to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking. Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of Imprimis to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs. Your generous support today will help us reach our Imprimis goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts. You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever! That's why, in addition to Imprimis , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our . These efforts include: Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics. Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week. Educating thousands of K-12 students in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics. I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for Imprimis and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable. Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to reach and teach increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government. Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation. Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyMkLFugzAURb_G3ogezwbjwUOkiKFSOnTpaNnwIK5sQMa0zd9XSPmArmc49-p83u3dhRiW-d0lMjnZvFtH1jv_jOtSeaLq1yKgrEBVCBb5aFqNqqs5mVphLRVqDfxhGkQxASG2bQdy6ppRtAASJKLWfhx5MKcHFEINAFJdBDV-mHDSWk5iajSTkGk7fAyDW5L7WnMoz8tChUfzKGXbmbgy7Bn2r3ue6DKsiWG_RbfsTPRHSTbRGI7ExI2SC5Fhe8J9PfJATNwcvcjg0ubCvDBx-7hf35q6Ex3PZtx-QoxhbxWTMJ-Gc4KXf7X5NvgXAAD__-9KaUc)

| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyMkLFugzAURb_G3ogezwbjwUOkiKFSOnTpaNnwIK5sQMa0zd9XSPmArmc49-p83u3dhRiW-d0lMjnZvFtH1jv_jOtSeaLq1yKgrEBVCBb5aFqNqqs5mVphLRVqDfxhGkQxASG2bQdy6ppRtAASJKLWfhx5MKcHFEINAFJdBDV-mHDSWk5iajSTkGk7fAyDW5L7WnMoz8tChUfzKGXbmbgy7Bn2r3ue6DKsiWG_RbfsTPRHSTbRGI7ExI2SC5Fhe8J9PfJATNwcvcjg0ubCvDBx-7hf35q6Ex3PZtx-QoxhbxWTMJ-Gc4KXf7X5NvgXAAD__-9KaUc)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---

On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck - and involved the department's helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home - and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver's side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner's life that afternoon - and probably his own. **But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric's case - exhausting his options through the justice system. _Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_ **A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric 's last remaining options for freedom.** **[Now you know why I'm asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2d1cf90c109a4edcbb637f82e426b62b&_e=YOCRY-1-VHlYdOXC2ZQkavvj1LzJLdkUqnEEnvR22IBAf5jvqHsXwGOJ91oW5pbJTv0Lzc5idaG09nwjocUUjQ8V7iSSI6Z5q2jbbdkzA6bR1O_YEcKKrJu5yEUSHPkDa-3cirEButBgPIw0FE3-ME2xO_iupI7hpwXmrtgaM7PZh4nDVGEgAMOQOtdZQ6r4ZGw_AGgmW0OdWrFZTUb4Bb7IqQNJUAp7Jk9-CwOgWNQZhzEZ02pBT5eQSqc6E6XcfBjzBWhFU5Bto2GzdeqbX66ofWq53l10wA_CgCSj8Cx9tu6PNuloQ_xg4MWkwvYkV-H0o83vgyhrkIfstckej8TzcLdPrPy7wzHUq376JT6Ydeo-KMK2Kjq1iwV90w8p)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I'm proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund - a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect's civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. ## More Than 30 Dems Now Want Biden Out
The Biden campaign [remained firm on Friday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO8yAQBOCnwR3WspCAC4q_cZe_vdIiZkk2whDZnK28_clXXzfSV8xovm7TLXDm8vgfFvIt1SnMjXearESQaCbTRZ-IkHRHXllUxmkFunt6oOD0PV6uyc12GBDTYKNDR3YArQx17BHQgEVQAEqrXsEFgr7YEK_JmQGEAYrc6tq_Kpf2pJQ_dae1n-vSZf9s7b0J_U_gKHA8jqOf71uhYztd4HhGgeOLiqxLyJk-MnLOtchIhWmTd46nfTdZkzy3yDXMJHDsVh_fB-fM29UKA48lcP5tbX9_sHv8CQAA__8_ol2P), rejecting reports of President Biden's potential withdrawal from the 2024 presidential race despite an increasing number of congressional Democrats calling for him to step down. According to a running list compiled by NBC News, more than 30 Democrats have publicly called for Biden to drop out of the race since Texas Representative Lloyd Doggett first called for a new nominee on July 2. [See the full list here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQRb8Gd1jDGINdUGzjLttuaREYJ7OLwTJsrPf3T0n96qurc3T-3Nab58T58dvv5NpWVh8av2i1EkGiXnUX3UaENHTklEWlp0HB0D3dZsDO42TuQ5iMmvWoZtCoLGirjNp0xw4BNVgEBaAG1SsYwQ-j9dFsk55BaKDIrZz938K5PWlLX-VFZx_K3iX3bO2oYvglcBG4XNfV53vIdNX3LnA5SuLGoQpc3iBJiULjkgUukfYSTt-qDD4leedIWdZGh_SVI8l2-vCP80P-P6JvVOVJ_vOt8gzZKwNmnrvTxePilLgaKzQ8ds_p49Z-LvVy-B0AAP__YlZqpQ). Even state-level Democrats have expressed desire for new leadership. subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsHkVhuWVN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osHkVhuWVN

Hello
Friend,

Take a
moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 -
trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things
rather than our Creator.

Have you
ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to
remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The
shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings,
our Savior, will return.

That's
the heart of Revelation.

Each day
on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale.
Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise
that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the
present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a
captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet
to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for
those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is
near.

This
isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about
revealing Jesus Christ.

When
Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by
humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns,
that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's
Revelation's essence.

As the
great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved
ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of
our King.

In my
brand-new book, Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's
Future Plans, I tackle five common questions about the end times.
We'll delve into:

1.
America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the
Antichrist?
2. The
Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this
apocalyptic event?
3. The
Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4. Gog
and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their
appearance?
5. The
Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New
Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster
your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the
unsure.

In
addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The
Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude
for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces
key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and
final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

I would
like to send you my brand-new book Mysteries of the End Times: 5
Truths About God's Future Plans and my brand-new resource "The
Major Characters of the End Times' as a thank you for your
generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of Pathway to
Victory.

Make your
generous gift here:
https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress

Pathway
to Victory is committed to equipping believers with biblical
teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of
Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio,
television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important
work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk
with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our
study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come
quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing
the Truth of God's Word,

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

subject: Where you can still see wagon tracks from the Oregon Trail
body:
In the grand scheme of world history, the Oregon Trail era wasn’t all that long ago, and the physical marks the wagons left behind are still very much visible in Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, Wyoming, Idaho, and, of course, Oregon. # [Wagon wheel tracks from the Oregon Trail are still visible.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgx59l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [U.S. History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgx59l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgx59l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| I n the grand scheme of world history, the Oregon Trail era wasn’t all that long ago, and the physical marks the wagons left behind are still very much visible in Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, Wyoming, Idaho, and, of course, Oregon. More than 300 miles of impressions left behind from heavy wagons can still be seen, sending modern-day travelers back in time to the mid-1800s, when hundreds of thousands people made the treacherous journey to America’s West Coast.
---
The famed path from Missouri to Oregon pushed through many different types of terrain, so each collection of tracks is unique. Some are wide, shallow indentations worn down in soft earth, while others still show individual wheel tracks. In harder terrain, such as sandstone, deep, angled impressions are still visible, some up to 5 feet deep. In a few places, the tracks tell their own story: Ash Hollow State Park in Nebraska still shows deep erosion from a hilly stretch of trail where travelers had to lock their wheels to keep from going too fast along the steep grade.
[Following the tracks](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgx59l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) can give modern-day road trippers a sense of the route that settlers took westward; helpfully, several highways are in roughly the same place as the original trail, so you never have to miss a historic park or roadside marker. Along I-84 in Oregon, even the rest areas have interpretive signage and, occasionally, yet more wheel tracks to transport you back in time.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgx59l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgx59l&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## The wagons weren’t for passengers.
Travelers along the Oregon Trail very rarely rode in their wagons. Walking alongside the wagon both allowed it to carry more weight and, perhaps surprisingly, made the journey more comfortable — walking 2,000 miles may be difficult, but try riding in a wagon full of cargo along rough terrain with absolutely no suspension for that long. Even the drivers guided their oxen from the ground. Despite being on foot, a wagon party could travel 20 whole miles on a good day.

clean_body: In the grand scheme of world history, the Oregon Trail era wasn’t all that long ago, and the physical marks the wagons left behind are still very much visible in Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, Wyoming, Idaho, and, of course, Oregon. | I n the grand scheme of world history, the Oregon Trail era wasn’t all that long ago, and the physical marks the wagons left behind are still very much visible in Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, Wyoming, Idaho, and, of course, Oregon. More than 300 miles of impressions left behind from heavy wagons can still be seen, sending modern-day travelers back in time to the mid-1800s, when hundreds of thousands people made the treacherous journey to America’s West Coast. The famed path from Missouri to Oregon pushed through many different types of terrain, so each collection of tracks is unique. Some are wide, shallow indentations worn down in soft earth, while others still show individual wheel tracks. In harder terrain, such as sandstone, deep, angled impressions are still visible, some up to 5 feet deep. In a few places, the tracks tell their own story: Ash Hollow State Park in Nebraska still shows deep erosion from a hilly stretch of trail where travelers had to lock their wheels to keep from going too fast along the steep grade. can give modern-day road trippers a sense of the route that settlers took westward; helpfully, several highways are in roughly the same place as the original trail, so you never have to miss a historic park or roadside marker. Along I-84 in Oregon, even the rest areas have interpretive signage and, occasionally, yet more wheel tracks to transport you back in time. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Length (in miles) of the Oregon Trail 2,170 | | Typical amount of time (in months) it took to complete the journey west 4-6 | Typical amount of time (in months) it took to complete the journey west 4-6 | | Percentage of Oregon Trail emigrants who succumbed to disease 6%-10% | | Copies of the Oregon Trail computer game sold 65 million | Copies of the Oregon Trail computer game sold 65 million | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- The wagons weren’t for passengers. Travelers along the Oregon Trail very rarely rode in their wagons. Walking alongside the wagon both allowed it to carry more weight and, perhaps surprisingly, made the journey more comfortable — walking 2,000 miles may be difficult, but try riding in a wagon full of cargo along rough terrain with absolutely no suspension for that long. Even the drivers guided their oxen from the ground. Despite being on foot, a wagon party could travel 20 whole miles on a good day. body:
Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.

| | | [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a5007521feb64a348a5f0f421850bfb6&_e=eEbVq0bP9sQA1wDvBpi0uOS4ibs-QG_orVSABJNflzYyERDNKiVBhu7ctdFdsw6W95VklGg3Ckb7D-591phik1LFqpUyVaFYAKlnZOfJ3F4QQxEV607D1IIWXilap78nTNxMZ-jcEvGxT5O2pBy9L-bJxRMQHRYpOvr2bvNnQqAwGhricWJX7LPo4ILDIDwESLTks9Cto0ExW0d46jmFqDSaCz3-vPICjMK9Q56WifhftMQquuRvVNb7AI7oXTZqSBC49O5tAMUjdKbryYX_Jg%3D%3D)

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a5007521feb64a348a5f0f421850bfb6&_e=eEbVq0bP9sQA1wDvBpi0uOS4ibs-QG_orVSABJNflzYyERDNKiVBhu7ctdFdsw6W95VklGg3Ckb7D-591phik1LFqpUyVaFYAKlnZOfJ3F4QQxEV607D1IIWXilap78n1_CMknq2ZlkhpjEq15XdQsJOzPqVvQ2jt4QCFtaPU4fiIztyEBIdfvxqr054ru1Cew0oXQlZiWJ9q9Ien30LeVTsCKLVRyjykV1RbSnaVXn9F1gVE4d4cPCw2krw2J3N6css3u7Lj3RMRbSjvpvkjg%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a5007521feb64a348a5f0f421850bfb6&_e=eEbVq0bP9sQA1wDvBpi0uOS4ibs-QG_orVSABJNflzYyERDNKiVBhu7ctdFdsw6W95VklGg3Ckb7D-591phik1LFqpUyVaFYAKlnZOfJ3F4QQxEV607D1IIWXilap78nmfwrfgC78z7gujWFNaWUxxUQ4xubEIRzXlYY-FHlS94VlgujIwDTL5jQICgByJK15vZRWf2DYSvXZtwdifUCJMgMuBPew7f2VNHtyBLdBQ2dkPBnUNWNSkyiE8mtRjjNvWUGBBnuPy-1hHb36LTiyQ%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---

subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.

| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=18bff916404c49f0bfb85d9fb7c8c119&_e=84JSWzb4cb2Ez7iCcdIwxBOvVshkE6w9VUhU_3HOKO5cDWSyIrI7zmXRBmwcSR5UICXoaqNK11C8FDsVZhwZbTte4Gutgkvt5LzEKlR9kNWgF-p3oZvq9OroCNH_oX0CIzuDM63-Q9i-2oa-_gw4Ksf536LORDV2WkYa0D1fF8hSD-4xolt-ij-go46mB_LEnL8fVHHhE8LFOZYLazoy93TEScdUMp7_M41fs7wZ2f_udAzBinKcQm8CfmgWhUBb4dLhOhrdEqrtlCl4U06X5g%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=18bff916404c49f0bfb85d9fb7c8c119&_e=84JSWzb4cb2Ez7iCcdIwxBOvVshkE6w9VUhU_3HOKO5cDWSyIrI7zmXRBmwcSR5UICXoaqNK11C8FDsVZhwZbTte4Gutgkvt5LzEKlR9kNWgF-p3oZvq9OroCNH_oX0CtQKJ00q8xcvSuxFI2CwJZQNZx4dy9yH-eTApiBbbWVv9ZVY8qbRiHzbQXU6a_Hfjo55OvDt1XGZkTf6-JBCSDME79wA0EAl6qBwpI_7nz46Su1BppnhHjsTSdFqn8prAVEoKzgtoGErKIeOa_4nhrg%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=18bff916404c49f0bfb85d9fb7c8c119&_e=84JSWzb4cb2Ez7iCcdIwxBOvVshkE6w9VUhU_3HOKO5cDWSyIrI7zmXRBmwcSR5UICXoaqNK11C8FDsVZhwZbTte4Gutgkvt5LzEKlR9kNWgF-p3oZvq9OroCNH_oX0CFCO64trNaOxqyIJUADf4cVx0Wvl4Yh5zkCCcGs32wX8WrIEHOpPnFZd18eUlbFrBu7sxLnoDTqnlXHta4lJju5zyU_Hqv9q1DLJFkkkEmBt2NXBfsGgnDRTW-wBwsozjLppWq2EBIwpatjlTnfb8xg%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=18bff916404c49f0bfb85d9fb7c8c119&_e=84JSWzb4cb2Ez7iCcdIwxBOvVshkE6w9VUhU_3HOKO5cDWSyIrI7zmXRBmwcSR5UICXoaqNK11C8FDsVZhwZbTte4Gutgkvt5LzEKlR9kNWgF-p3oZvq9OroCNH_oX0CG9FYfLo5FTcos9P6z9EfQsXC4qkZcb9aH4CrYEapWARKu_oPQCEX30GQIU56xkwWn_tcoA5YwuGI3G7mjqPkqtk0PEq3sDSO9adkTA7QrgUlz2FUpcLeyGhbTPnKXC9dV3doCJQ632K_u6k4pJbwcA%3D%3D)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely, Seth Dillon

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: What you can do to defeat ‘woke’ ideology
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/educationstandards-11572851?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**“Woke” ideology is everywhere.** Over the past thirty years, it has captured much of America.

Like many people, I once assumed that young Americans who dabbled in a little political correctness at college would soon grow out of it when they left. **I was wrong.**
---
|
---
_Values matter._
| **Rather than change when they entered the world of work, many college graduates changed the workplace.** Today there is hardly an HR department in corporate America that is not committed to promoting Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI).

A generation ago, corporate America did not know what a preferred pronoun was. Today you cannot apply for a job without declaring yours.

**DEI means that Martin Luther King’s vision of a color-blind meritocracy is slipping away.** Obama’s election to the White House was supposed to herald a post-racial America. America today feels like it is increasingly re-racialized.
---
|
---
_Too many young people have been infected by the 'woke' mind virus._
| **Conservative America needs to launch a concerted fight back.** It is not enough to hope that Congress passes legislation. An Executive Order by our state Governor won’t be enough.

**We need to take action to ensure our own families are immunized against the woke mind-virus.**

Born in Britain, I moved with my family to America by choice. Concerned at the woke nonsense all over social media, I did not want my young daughter to grow up seeing things that way. So, I started to tell her what I felt she needed to know about our new home.

**America, I explained, was founded in liberty.** Sure, I joked, the first Americans might have beaten Brits like us at Yorktown, but the important thing is that liberty that won.
---
| |
---
We talked about why the US Constitution is one of the best systems of government in the world. The Founders, we discussed, borrowed from both the English and the Roman tradition (There’s a reason the Senate is called the Senate).

America might be a superpower, I would say, but America has for the most part used that strength wisely. The United States has not built an empire, but used her might to set other people free.
---
| In our kitchen, I pointed at all the everyday objects around us – light bulbs, microwaves, iPhones – to illustrate that Americans are remarkably inventive.

**Discussing****George Washington’s letter****to the congregation at Touro synagogue, I explained that Jewish and Christian beliefs are the key to understanding Americans’ strong sense of individualism.**

As we celebrated our first Thanksgiving, I told her it was a chance for every American to feel gratitude for being here, whether your ancestors arrived at the end of the last ice age, or like our family, a few months earlier.

**No matter how carefully we raise our children, it is inevitable that as they grow up they will be exposed to the “woke” mind virus.** Teaching them these basic truths about America, I believe, will give them an antidote against it.

**If we do not teach our families these truths about America, TikTok and progressive professors will fill the void.**

That’s why I decided to take these six lessons and turn it into an illustrated children’s story book, “**What Makes America Special**.” I want every child to know these truths about America.

Find out what you can do to ensure the next generation in your family knows the truth about this country by clicking on the button below.
---
|
---
| [Click here to learn more about this project!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=b1c05f7c44&e=5703353baa "Click here to learn more about this project!")
---
| Take it from me as an immigrant when I tell you that this is an extraordinary country.

America’s success is not a question of having lots of natural resources. The American achievement cannot be attributed to geography or the climate. This country is exceptional not because the laws of physics are any different over here.

**The United States has flourished because of decisions made in a courthouse in Philadelphia in the summer of 1787, which hardwired freedom into the DNA of the young Republic.** So long as America stays true to that tradition, each generation of Americans will bequeath an even greater country.

**It is essential we pass on knowledge of that tradition to the next generation.**

Have an awesome weekend!
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

|

name: Hillsdale College via Old Glory Today
subject: The Battle for Truth
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Old Glory Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_O8kKcaXkeL7KKxLy3GpXw~~/AARclAA~/RgRofkOoP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2RlZmVuZC1saWJlcnR5P3NjPTAxNDAyTjAyNDJMQ1pET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1pbXByaW1pcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDcyMFcDc3BjQgpmlX-xm2buYh8oUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_O8kKcaXkeL7KKxLy3GpXw~~/AARclAA~/RgRofkOoP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2RlZmVuZC1saWJlcnR5P3NjPTAxNDAyTjAyNDJMQ1pET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1pbXByaW1pcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDcyMFcDc3BjQgpmlX-xm2buYh8oUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_O8kKcaXkeL7KKxLy3GpXw~~/AARclAA~/RgRofkOoP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2RlZmVuZC1saWJlcnR5P3NjPTAxNDAyTjAyNDJMQ1pET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1pbXByaW1pcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDcyMFcDc3BjQgpmlX-xm2buYh8oUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_O8kKcaXkeL7KKxLy3GpXw~~/AARclAA~/RgRofkOoP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2RlZmVuZC1saWJlcnR5P3NjPTAxNDAyTjAyNDJMQ1pET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1pbXByaW1pcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1MT05HX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDcyMFcDc3BjQgpmlX-xm2buYh8oUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.
---
| |

Old Glory Today
