Dear Peter,
BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard, Bill Gates own 88% of the S&P 500.
They’re now buying our agricultural landscapes and our single-family homes ... [so our young people can’t afford to buy a home anymore.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fight_for_you_rs_7_19_nd_1&n=3)
These big billionaires and giant corporations [have turned our country into a colony](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fight_for_you_rs_7_19_nd_1&n=4).
Thomas Jefferson said that American democracy was rooted in the control of the landscapes by tens of thousands of independent farmers, each with a stake in our democracy.
Now, we’re going away from that.
We’re going from an ownership society to a renters’ society.
When we do that, we go from being free citizens to mere subjects, entirely at the mercy of the powerful.
[We’re on track to be subjected to these giant corporations who have no Patriotism, no love for America, and indeed no loyalty to you.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fight_for_you_rs_7_19_nd_1&n=5)
Robert F. Kennedy will reverse these trends. He will stand up for the middle and working class and for a re-industrialization of America, and he will defend your rights and our Constitution.
[Please help us take the White House in November with a generous contribution today. When no one else will, Bobby will fight for you!](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fight_for_you_rs_7_19_nd_1&n=6)

Thank you for your continued support!

clean_body: We’re on track to be subjected to these giant corporations who have no Patriotism, no love for America, and indeed no loyalty to you. | | | | | Dear Peter, BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard, Bill Gates own 88% of the S&P 500. They’re now buying our agricultural landscapes and our single-family homes ... These big billionaires and giant corporations . Thomas Jefferson said that American democracy was rooted in the control of the landscapes by tens of thousands of independent farmers, each with a stake in our democracy. Now, we’re going away from that. We’re going from an ownership society to a renters’ society. When we do that, we go from being free citizens to mere subjects, entirely at the mercy of the powerful. Robert F. Kennedy will reverse these trends. He will stand up for the middle and working class and for a re-industrialization of America, and he will defend your rights and our Constitution. name: Tim Kaine
subject: I should be debating my opponent today, but he refused…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Folks,
If my opponent hadn’t refused to debate me, today would have been the Virginia Bar Association debate. The debate’s been held in the Commonwealth for decades (I’ve done it in both my gubernatorial and Senate races) and gives Virginians the opportunity to hear clearly from the candidates about their positions and beliefs.
Hung Cao ducked the debate, so we didn't get that chance. But I’m not letting that stop me from talking with Virginia voters about this election!
Here’s what I’m doing today:
I’m so excited to kick off the day in Staunton with volunteers who will be going door to door to talk with their neighbors about the stakes in November. Talking to your neighbors is a really great way to have meaningful conversations about the issues and make sure people know how and when to go vote, so I’m really grateful for all these volunteers who are headed out to the doors.
(Coincidentally, Staunton is home to the newspaper that my opponent called “podunk” after they wrote a story about him that he didn’t care for... It’s also where Anne and I honeymooned nearly 40 years ago!)
Next up, I’m going to be visiting a few small businesses in Staunton to hear from business owners. Helping small businesses and start-ups grow and thrive is such an important priority for us in the Senate, and I’m pleased that legislation like the American Rescue Plan has contributed to their successes here in Virginia.
Then I’ll head to Waynesboro to tour three small businesses and talk with folks about how we can continue to increase access to capital and lower barriers to entry for women and minority entrepreneurs.
And I’ll cap off the day with a fun meet and greet with the Waynesboro Democratic Committee, where we can chat about what’s on people’s minds and get pumped up for the work ahead in this election.
I’m so looking forward to being out on the trail today, hearing from voters and having conversations with folks — it’s days like this that help inform what we do in the Senate and help me prioritize the issues that matter most to you.
We’ve got just over three months to go until Election Day, and the stakes are only getting higher. I’m working as hard as I can to make sure I hold onto my seat, retain our Democratic majority, and keep Virginia blue.
If you’re with me, will you show your support with an online donation today? Just $5 or $10 would mean a lot, because those contributions add up and let us build meaningful voter outreach all across Virginia. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thanks a lot. I really appreciate you!
-Tim Kaine

name: Charlie Kirk, TPUSA
subject: Can I send you my new book?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWq-OWuWN2
We're in a moment of national reflection.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWq-OWuWN2

Friend,

We're in
a moment of national reflection.

And for
many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our
culture, institutions, and daily lives-for the better.

Friend,
over the past year, I wrote my new book, Right Wing Revolution,
as a guide for a return to an America where…

We
are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief
in American Greatness.

We
have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our
Constitution.

We
have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide
spiritual renewal.

We
trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have
to lock our doors at night.

We
bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with
integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for
all Americans.

Can I
send you a FREE copy of Right Wing Revolution to read today? All
I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning
Point USA-and our critically important work to make kids LOVE
AMERICA again.

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

Friend,
I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book
you've read from the Right before:

It's
NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between
Left and Right.

It's
NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I
do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

It's
NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference -
instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our
country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving
ourselves.

I want to
get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as
possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover
edition for FREE.

All I ask
for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning
Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

In this
defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a
spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to
find all that's possible in the days ahead.

Thank YOU
for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of
Turning Point USA.

For
America,

Charlie
Kirk
Founder &
CEO
Turning
Point USA

Support
Turning Point USA

4940 East
Beverly Road
Phoenix,
Arizona 85044

subject: Happy Pennsylvania Day, Peter

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3614%2E552475%2EyegE1f)
Happy Pennsylvania Day, Peter.
**[To celebrate, will you chip in $7.20 to my re-election campaign?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240720-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240720-1&refcode2=3614_552475_yegE1f&akid=3614%2E552475%2EyegE1f)**
Pennsylvania is my home, and it always will be.
It’s where I was born, where I grew up, and where Terese and I raised our family.
It’s also where I started a career in public service that has always been about fighting for Pennsylvania families.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240720-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240720-1&refcode2=3614_552475_yegE1f&akid=3614%2E552475%2EyegE1f)
Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m proud of the fights we’ve won together.
I’m running for re-election because there are fights we still must win together — like the fight for voting rights, women’s rights, and workers’ rights; the fight to lower costs for working families; and the fight for our children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities.
But this is going to be my toughest race yet. My opponent, who is worth hundreds of millions of dollars, has already invested millions into his own campaign and has the support of Wall Street billionaires.
This is gearing up to be one of the most expensive Senate races in the Nation, and all eyes will be on our campaign to see if we have what it takes to keep Pennsylvania blue.
**[With the Senate majority hinging on this seat, your support is more important than ever. So what do you say? I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

| |

---
| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=0a9eea16bf1f41e09dd584099750d720&_e=R1ZYcjlI3w-KFf8Kg8PSF0v63AOs34k0wjX50hWxJQPESLPD7JX1UEfyAepJyT3seWY30njxzz_ebejXqYeJEbu5ke6LaZdbe3jS8LsR4w716YbhWkuXJWf4TQJu-tC_gUbpsfkxv1thhtgj_Rs_YXtYibRQ1tIrzZzhaG8yAifRRcBwybRr5Hk_W6lxmVW49w-puiYuqEmQx4CrJ9Oo18U3gAgBJJoLAHkaIDJ0PAJ6vOR0svH9_Hrg1JnzS6Fiy2KRWOb7XkXNWjVYScxXp2_X6zseP1WSMnrx0-lUOa73VTTFgOXrtRlZ4TfJTeyvFE-FQwgLiTrqZuPTxLjX9ZS4_ZcOrHsKnqdTAaZMuLIpoPjcqN-Xy4pAVKgOdGIOC1IRKyZqkD_HfOnbGUWqkaNTvJRbBckHKKpquJdeNuA%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. But desperate times call for desperate measures. And if that's what it'll take to win, I'm willing to chase down every lead.

If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Will you do what it takes to hand Joe Biden and the Democrats a humiliating defeat?

5 reasons why we MUST defend the Senate

Derek,
There are plenty of reasons why we need to do whatever it takes to defend our narrow Senate majority, but I’ll do my best to narrow down the list to 5.
[**Before I do that, would you please consider chipping in $5 — _just $1 for each of the 5 reasons below_ — to help me and John Fetterman defeat Republican Larry Hogan and keep Maryland’s Senate seat blue?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240720?refcode=em20240720-9230&refcode2=9230_434096_I7WAHE&akid=9230%2E434096%2EI7WAHE)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240720?amount=5&refcode=em20240720-9230&refcode2=9230_434096_I7WAHE&akid=9230%2E434096%2EI7WAHE)**
Alright, Derek, here we go!
1. **Abortion rights:** Republican legislators are rolling back abortion rights around the country. One of Senate Republicans’ top priorities is to pass a national abortion ban.
2. **Climate crisis:** We can’t take chances when it comes to preserving our planet. Democrats passed the largest investment in green energy and jobs in our country’s history, and Republicans are eager to repeal it.
3. **Voting rights:** When more people vote, Republicans lose. So the GOP wants to make it harder for people to vote by chipping away at the Voting Rights Act and passing voting restrictions.
4. **Lowering costs:** A Republican-controlled Senate would pass another massive tax cut for corporations and the ultra-wealthy, leaving working families to shoulder the burden.
5. **The Supreme Court:** We’ve already seen the far-right court overturn _Roe_ and overrule student debt relief. Democrats need Senate control to have a say in future nominations.

_For all these reasons (and so many more), we MUST defend our majority, Derek. But if we lose in Maryland, Republicans have a clear path to taking the Senate._
[**We need to raise another $5,000 by midnight to keep our fundraising on track to hit our goal. Can I count on you to chip in just $5, $25, or even $50 to help me and John Fetterman defeat Larry Hogan and fend off a GOP takeover?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240720?refcode=em20240720-9230&refcode2=9230_434096_I7WAHE&akid=9230%2E434096%2EI7WAHE)

Thanks,
Angela Alsobrooks

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: just one month away
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
| | |
---
Hi there, friend, it’s Debbie. I can't believe we're only **one month** away from the Florida primary.
It's because of people like you that I'm here today, running in a battleground race that could determine the fate of our Senate majority and the next Senate majority leader. **Thank you, friend.**
My mother, sisters, and I all came to the United States in search of a better life when I was 14 years old. **And while we had big dreams for the future, our path forward wasn't easy.** I worked in a doughnut shop to help support my family, and I watched my mother work double shifts to take care of my sisters and me.
After putting myself through college and working at environmental and gun violence prevention organizations, I decided to run for Congress in 2018 — **and I flipped a red seat blue.** It was here that I wrote the bill to **expand seniors’ Medicare coverage, provided economic relief to families and small businesses, and secured $200 million for Everglades restoration.**
**I have a strong track record of fighting for Florida families, friend, but my work isn't done.** **Now, I'm heading into Florida's Democratic primary, ready to win my official nomination for U.S. Senate and finally retire my extremist opponent, Rick Scott. **

As Zepp-LaRouche said at the International Peace Coalition meeting on Friday, the world came within less than an inch of a chaotic plunge toward WWIII when the assassin's bullet grazed former President Donald Trump's head at the Pennsylvania rally. This assassination attempt did not occur in isolation, and it isn't merely about the U.S. election. Remember that Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico was nearly killed on May 15, when he was struck by several bullets fired by another alleged "lone assassin."
Like Fico, former President Trump has said repeatedly that he intends to bring the Ukraine-Russia war to an end. He also truthfully said that "Ukraine is not winning this war." Hungarian PM Viktor Orban, who has been on a whirlwind tour meeting with the leaders of Ukraine, Russia, and China, also met with Trump while in the U.S. for the NATO 75th Anniversary meeting which was presided over by a senile President Biden, and which adopted measures to escalate the war against Russia and potentially China.
We are in the midst of a planet-wide struggle over the principles of the American Revolution, now being upheld by nations of the global south, who are asserting their independence and right to economic sovereignty, vs the global NATO dictatorship, which is seeking to provoke war, even thermo-nuclear war, against Russia, China, Iran and maybe others.
Americans must not fall into the trap of thinking small, and only looking at the evidence under their nose. If we do that, mankind will be lost. For example, is it a coincidence that the American tour of Israeli war criminal Bibi Netanyahu comes on the heels of this assassination attempt, and the NATO summit in Washington, D.C.? Does his visit at this time open a dangerous potential for another destabilizing event, which will be used to fan the flames of war? I don't believe in coincidences. Join us Monday night.

---
Dear Derek, We are sure you didn't wake up and think to yourself, "today is the day I am going to make a donation to the Democratic National Committee." But that’s what we need all Democrats to do today: A few weeks ago, and maybe lost in the news, the Trump campaign and the Republican National Committee announced they raised $331 million in the second quarter of the year. Let us repeat that: $331 million. It's scary stuff. That is money they will use to try to defeat Joe Biden and Democrats running down the ballot in November. In fact, they are using it right now to run ads in swing states across the country. So... here we are. Arguably at a make-or-break moment for Democrats up and down the ballot, and the only way we can fight back to win is if we have the resources. Fellow Patriot, My name is Hung Cao. I am a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines defusing bombs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces; I also conducted some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=c5b358726f56449b97390a08bdcad0bd&_e=U9DNxi6rVcJhjFfMgvk621eFPC8FIJKko6mVaDlp5Zqgeb9T-lbpNWAs_3mdhd6AzdAvtHkQvp8GM1Tjgag3pcg8HzeiSkxkqVXLHXec3HRkuU0TVzevv5W2b5bTewBmPnelBm4TyqSuj6qfG4GN2Yu9aHx4FQc36sg58U0rQrh2McpAArB4svpKYXC1Z70VK01whsb2AiQR72K4Lnk7mIJg49A7jgdPcCN2QmPe1Z9Fmvh9boAzEOrA1vOLGJRE8svOtWSWx-ZC5DwkonUeB3R3E0pQvkhaQwwIH3-RfXihcOwDg6J7eEbXMqfan-DcarxXfRJFmZZ_0CeaG4MCupL1gek47ouac4V8AeCRYexTWX-Pk7NT8QT4_Ko8KRJc)

I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. **My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after the fall of Saigon. **
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=c5b358726f56449b97390a08bdcad0bd&_e=U9DNxi6rVcJhjFfMgvk621eFPC8FIJKko6mVaDlp5Zqgeb9T-lbpNWAs_3mdhd6AzdAvtHkQvp8GM1Tjgag3pcg8HzeiSkxkqVXLHXec3HRkuU0TVzevv5W2b5bTewBmPnelBm4TyqSuj6qfG4GN2Yu9aHx4FQc36sg58U0rQrh2McpAArB4svpKYXC1Z70VK01whsb2AiQR72K4Lnk7mCwjyDDTtNztaa_9JbPF3IovRNk_dyWNH53fn9_H8DqcApE8ky0Lfyjg8Mo4VjoSSe7WdxdX4yGwFom7pRderqAkWaNX8YT3_6bRW5xR_hIwPrIziJdIu2kfGewXxG-DW-W5IuszJySd8Sc0PALPFHMyKE0DvY_1H0LBw-D3kAHT)
---
_If it wasn't for America, I probably wouldn't be alive today._

name: David Hogg, Leaders We Deserve
subject: Our promise to you
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Last week, we sent out a survey to our donors for some feedback on how we’ve been doing. 📊
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240720&t=1&akid=965%2E587540%2EhQrRWr)
Peter,
Last week, we sent out a survey to our donors for some feedback on how we’ve been doing. 📊
By the way, we don’t just send surveys as a front to solicit donations. As many organizations do. We actually read every response and have learned so much from the questions you’ve answered. I literally pulled out a white board and charted the results with our staff (photo below). It’s our promise to you that we will share the results of these surveys with you promptly after we send them out.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240720?refcode=em20240720&amount=5&refcode2=965_587540_hQrRWr&akid=965%2E587540%2EhQrRWr)
[**Didn’t get the survey? Click here to make your first contribution and join the thousands of folks supporting Leaders We Deserve.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240720?refcode=em20240720&amount=5&refcode2=965_587540_hQrRWr&akid=965%2E587540%2EhQrRWr) Now, here’s a look at what we found:
**When asked what level of impact donors thought their contributions made, 43% said low to no impact. 🙁**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240720?refcode=em20240720&amount=5&refcode2=965_587540_hQrRWr&akid=965%2E587540%2EhQrRWr)
**That couldn’t be further from the truth, Peter.**
Your donations have helped us win important races. $5 can mean the difference between going the extra mile to reach just one more voter — and often in competitive races, that’s all it takes!
Let’s take Molly Cook as an example:
Election night results showed that Molly was down by about 400 votes for most of the night. A ton of people actually thought she had already lost. To the point I was so exhausted from poll watching in Houston that day I went back to our Holiday Inn. But at midnight right as I was going to bed I refreshed the election results page, with all the votes finally counted, _**she was up by only 64 votes**_ — and today she’s the youngest, most progressive, and first openly LGBTQ+ member of the Texas State Senate as a result.
This consequential election was decided by 64 votes. If we weren’t there to support her campaign and reach just that many more voters, we would not be able to celebrate such a huge win for progressives in Texas. When the stakes are this high, even the smallest effort goes a long way. The VAST majority of our funding comes from small dollar donors like you. It’s part of our model because when we have that many donors we can focus on one thing — electing principled leaders who aren’t owned by corporations and are loyal only to their constituents.
👉 **Your donations have a real big impact and are helping to build the future of the progressive movement one election and one dollar at a time.**
So, we hope you’ll consider making your first donation as we get into the heat of the election. You can even take that step today! Make a $5 contribution by clicking on your personal link below:
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240720?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240720?refcode=em20240720&refcode2=965_587540_hQrRWr&akid=965%2E587540%2EhQrRWr)
Thank you for all that you do!
We literally couldn’t do this without you. When we started Leaders We Deserve we had no money. It was a huge risk but because over 5,000 of you believed in us in our first month, we were able to make this dream a reality.
Thank you for making this possible and know that every single dollar you donate matters. Sometimes you may even get a call from me — thanking you for being a small dollar donor! (Just this week I thanked David D. from Miami, FL and Charlotte from Oxford, PA!)
THANK YOU,
David Hogg
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20240720&t=2&refcode2=965_587540_hQrRWr&akid=965%2E587540%2EhQrRWr)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:

It’s part of our model because when we have that many donors we can focus on one thing — electing principled leaders who aren’t owned by corporations and are loyal only to their constituents. 👉 Your donations have a real big impact and are helping to build the future of the progressive movement one election and one dollar at a time. So, we hope you’ll consider making your first donation as we get into the heat of the election. You can even take that step today! Make a $5 contribution by clicking on your personal link below: Thank you for all that you do! We literally couldn’t do this without you. When we started Leaders We Deserve we had no money. It was a huge risk but because over 5,000 of you believed in us in our first month, we were able to make this dream a reality. Thank you for making this possible and know that every single dollar you donate matters. Sometimes you may even get a call from me — thanking you for being a small dollar donor! (Just this week I thanked David D. from Miami, FL and Charlotte from Oxford, PA!) THANK YOU, David Hogg

Me and my sisters when we were (much) younger

Sleeping on the floor in our apartment growing up because we couldn’t afford a bed wasn’t easy.
Working to make ends meet while I was trying to get into a good school wasn’t easy.
Serving in Iraq in one of the hardest hit units of the entire war definitely wasn’t easy.
And running for the U.S. Senate — having Kari Lake attack me day in, day out, while Trump helps her raise millions to smear my name... that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my family.
Getting into school and building a better life, I had a strong community supporting me.
Getting through Iraq, I had my brothers watching my back.
And in this campaign, I have you.
Simply put... I couldn’t do this without your support, FIRST. When you woke up this morning you probably didn’t think it’d be the day you made a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat Kari Lake and defend Arizona and control of the U.S. Senate.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Update: a Super PAC targeting me has now raked in $2 million from three massive donations
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
We have to be able to push back against big money from special interests and national Republicans.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2275%2E4032634%2EklAdge)
---
Things are moving quickly here:**In the past week, we found out that a Super PAC trying to defeat me has now raked in $2 million from three massive donations.** **That’s over half a million more than our campaign raised in our most recent fundraising quarter.** [**We have to be able to push back. I wouldn’t ask if it weren’t powerfully important: Can you pitch in $5 or whatever amount makes sense for you right now to support our re-election campaign?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2424?amount=5&t=8&akid=2275%2E4032634%2EklAdge)

I want to talk for a moment about where the Super PAC’s $2 million came from: a crypto firm and two crypto billionaires. That’s no accident. Ever since I began speaking out about how the crypto industry should follow the same basic rules as banks and all other financial institutions, the crypto lobby has been upset with me. And now they are pouring money into this race. Crypto-financed special interests think they can buy this Senate seat and hand the Senate majority to the Republicans. I’m working for working people, not crypto billionaires. That will never change. But the big money that we’re now up against makes our grassroots fundraising numbers even more critical. In the latest fundraising quarter, the average amount people donated to our campaign was about $25. That is a sign of how we are building a grassroots campaign. And that is exactly the type of campaign I want to run — one that centers working people, advocates for working people, and puts power in the hands of working people. Thousands of supporters chipping in $25 at a time — vs. two billionaires and one company fueling a Super PAC. I’ll take this team any day of the week. But this type of grassroots fundraising model only works if everyone keeps pitching in whatever they can, whenever they can. This is the difference between a government that works great for those at the top and a government that can work for everyone. [**So if you can keep powering our grassroots campaign today, please make a donation of any amount so that we can compete and continue working for working people.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2424?t=14&akid=2275%2E4032634%2EklAdge) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

name: Megan via Team Sara
subject: The cost of flipping the House
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Hey there, Megan here from Team Sara. If we haven’t met yet, I’m glad to be connecting with you today.
I’ve been working with Sara Jacobs for a long time now (nine years and counting!), and one of the things she relies on me for is, for lack of better words, real talk . I never sugar-coat things, and I’m borderline obsessive about tracking how much money we need to accomplish our goals.
So I thought I’d share some real talk with you directly, instead of just going through Sara. Here goes:
Flipping the House is an expensive proposition. We’re talking about hundreds of millions of dollars to compete with a well-funded GOP hell-bent on holding onto their power.
And that money won’t just magically appear. Sure, sometimes big checks are written – and that’s an incredibly valuable resource for many campaigns. But grassroots donations can be – dollar for dollar – even more important. When you’ve got a ton of people pitching in little by little, you’re able to scale up in a way you can’t necessarily do if you’re relying on just a few generous donors.
That’s one reason you get so many emails asking for money. Candidates and campaigns know how critical your support is, and we all know how high the stakes are in November.

There has never been a more important time to work hard for our Democracy and show the unwavering strength of unity. It's time to rise up.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aboutbob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aboutbob]
With the election day on Tues. Aug. 6 fast approaching, every contribution made now is crucial. Your support will power critical outreach projects that will reach thousands of voters. Let's seize this moment and continue the momentum.
CONTRIBUTE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aboutbob]
Friend,
I know sometimes the news can be discouraging. Nationally, the media has a knack for making one side feel defeated before a ballot is even cast. I aim to offer you hope for a better day and a brighter future. It's not just rhetoric. It's all about possibilities. When we are united, nothing is out of reach.
Now is a time to dig deep, and find encouragement at the local level, at the Congressional level, with down-ballot races. When I turn off the TV and get out to talk to voters, it's clear - we know the difference between media hype and real, organic, grassroots momentum.
Friends, remember, it's not always a brand or idol that changes the course of the nation. It has been people's movements . And, from where I stand, I see that Americans are fired up to keep our democracy going — fired up but maybe uncertain.
I'm here to tell you that if you're ready to help move rural America forward, stand up to extremism, and keep up the fight — not a fight against our fellow Americans, but a fight for a cause — you are not alone.
We've been working for 35 months to start a new narrative with our neighbors, and our work will pay off.
We have power in perseverance. It's our tenacity and grit that will spark change. When we're knocked down, we get back up. When all of us keep our heads held high, w e have power in numbers at the ballot box.
You are not just a supporter; but a crucial part of this campaign. You're making a difference. Please continue to volunteer, spread the word through social media, talk to your friends and family, and if you're financially able, contribute.
Our campaign is about the grassroots power of the people, not corporate PACs, not dark money. It's about hardworking everyday people chipping in what they can, when they can, to evoke change. You can trust that your support is going towards a campaign ready to win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aboutbob]
Let's turn out in a big way on Tues. Aug. 6 and show our strength towards November.
Onward!
-Bob

Friend, I’m not telling you this only in hopes that you’ll rush for your pocket book. I’m telling you this because I want you to know what type of man my husband is. This is Amy Brown and my husband Sam Brown is the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in Nevada. I first met my husband in the burn unit when he returned from Afghanistan after a roadside bomb exploded under his vehicle. There was one thing about Sam that caught my attention immediately. It wasn’t the burns on his body, it wasn’t the scars on the face. His vibrant faith in God glowed brightly even in his darkest days. Everyone that encountered Sam could see it. For me, Sam was a light that guided me, challenged me, and reconnected me with God and the Church. I had grown up in the Church but had lost my Faith – I was at my rock bottom until I met Sam. During that time, I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced. He told me he was concerned for my Salvation – and for that matter so was I. **[That brought us to where we are today, 15 years later. We have 3 kids and I’m a Bible-believing momma who puts Bible lessons in our family's homeschool curriculum.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=9d40c9e1587f4e84aa2a017e8e5d21cc&_e=cL1C3z6SakmdQNUiSP8wJs8tkaxst1VzKFHWdbswlxWV1VQ7FxILgN1Hw5-5LFbhC7ANFpd5QWey7_KwciTdcraEdoxBiN9DkguvVZRdWuPiv227kAw8LO9AZIqfjRP5WWJGqXQknvVU7gazdp3h1GvlPQ9FFcL-Aa1GUIV4mX_ifWQdEBGB4TEye6HJ9lju_CgG-iXnqMMDlhdwc7TgyHS8-Bic2n7PDrLs62rp9qIiLW8CfHbF4tMIDbfxb-vZphU0Tl2PkcVgftEVEjg1j2F1cLBkDCih-BgXC03Z8KUoHeRY-vfRT7q-Xy4ZZzCl6Ic8f4eYdVctVrnY748ZXCg-DmqE4n5dK9dToNRvQXRB-uDHiWeBf4acg7yOA1KxkFKM97LYwgpkneW31_vwBo5K6jKnCaehRzctbiE68ctjY0KgFFNFf_5H71JdF3BnB7M4A3tM3eHGIjVAaF_6SQ%3D%3D)** Friend, if i hadn't gone through my darkest days, I may have never met Sam and never found a way back to God the way that I did. **[Everything Sam had planned to do with his life changed in 60 seconds in Afghanistan, but it never changed who he was.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=9d40c9e1587f4e84aa2a017e8e5d21cc&_e=cL1C3z6SakmdQNUiSP8wJs8tkaxst1VzKFHWdbswlxWV1VQ7FxILgN1Hw5-5LFbhC7ANFpd5QWey7_KwciTdcraEdoxBiN9DkguvVZRdWuPiv227kAw8LO9AZIqfjRP5WWJGqXQknvVU7gazdp3h1GvlPQ9FFcL-Aa1GUIV4mX_ifWQdEBGB4TEye6HJ9lju_CgG-iXnqMMDlhdwc7TgyHS8-Bic2n7PDrLs62rp9qIiLW8CfHbF4tMIDbfxb-vZphU0Tl2PkcVgftEVEjg1j2F1cLBkDCih-BgXC03Z8KUoHeRY-vfRT7q-Xy4ZZzCly4z3w4orM8oQrar5OZI02n9T4Z9HUoRM1-g_WW2gi0YFpNDjZhzzJ6VNfGdPuuptobvlWc1UIC2xlMhyf4pnSqD7qqDADFExd-iPGhsyTP4rdhFv0Qy0nyGfz9O2SOKw2s0t64FSS_0kKTehaUWXJQ%3D%3D) ** His faith never wavered. His hope never left him. His dedication and desire to serve has not faded to this day. Although he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he never stopped fighting for others. I'll be honest with you. body:
#
As we know, a lot is going on — and things are developing pretty quickly — in the world of politics right now.
Early Friday morning, Alexandria got onto Instagram Live to talk about everything that we’re seeing in the media about Joe Biden.
As she puts it at the beginning of the video, **“If you are of the opinion that Joe Biden should be replaced as the nominee, I am not here to dismiss or attack you on that — but I just want you to know what _I’m_ seeing.”**
Alexandria spoke to her concerns about the GOP’s readiness to legally challenge ballot changes in swing states, the Supreme Court becoming involved in the election in any way, and more. [Take a look at her full remarks here →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/29487?utm_source=em20240720-6839&t=1&akid=6839%2E2526796%2E9IGQRf)
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/29487?utm_source=em20240720-6839&t=2&akid=6839%2E2526796%2E9IGQRf)
[Watch the video on IG → ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/29487?utm_source=em20240720-6839&t=3&akid=6839%2E2526796%2E9IGQRf)
Last week, Alexandria called out anonymous "senior Democrats" who had "resigned themselves to a second Trump presidency." In the Instagram Live on Friday, she addressed them again:
_If you’re an everyday person that has this opinion, I’m not angry with you. But this whole class of people who are coming with this other opinion now have supported the President the entire time — and many of those people are the same people who closed ranks around anybody who wanted to raise this conversation a year ago._
_What I will say is what upsets me is [Democrats] saying we will lose. For me, to a certain extent, I don’t care what name is on there:_we are not losing_. I don’t know about you, but **my community does not have the option to lose**. My community does not have the luxury of accepting loss in July of an election year. My people are the first ones deported. They’re the first ones put in [our broken carceral system]. They’re the first ones whose families are killed by war._
Thank you for watching,
Team AOC

[](https://www.facebook.com/OcasioCortez/?t=4&akid=6839%2E2526796%2E9IGQRf) | [](https://twitter.com/AOC?t=5&akid=6839%2E2526796%2E9IGQRf) | [](https://www.instagram.com/aoc/?t=6&akid=6839%2E2526796%2E9IGQRf)

In Trump’s speech to the RNC, he praised Viktor Orban — the repressive Hungarian leader who has undermined democracy in his own country for more than a decade.
Orban met with Trump in Mar-a-Lago just a little while ago, right after Orban had traveled to meet with Putin and Xi Jinping.

He’s praised them, he’s positioned himself to align with them, and in the case of Putin he’s reworked the majority of the Republican Party to enable his illegal and immoral invasion of Ukraine.
Just thirty years ago the Republican Party would have rejected Trump without hesitation. Today, he leads them.
If the GOP won’t stand against dictators around the world, won’t stand for democracy, for our allies, and for the international order that has built unprecedented prosperity and peace... it falls to us.

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3615%2E552475%2EROda6t)
It’s no secret that we are huge fans of Pennsylvania here on Team Casey. There’s so much to love about our Commonwealth, we could go on and on...
Before we do though, the Finance team made us promise to ask: [**Can you chip in $5 to continue fighting for Pennsylvanians in the U.S. Senate?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240720-2?refcode=em20240720-2&refcode2=3615_552475_ROda6t&akid=3615%2E552475%2EROda6t)
For Pennsylvania Day, we wanted to spell out some fun facts about the Commonwealth you might not have known before.
**Pennsylvania leads the country in the number of pretzel bakeries.** 45 pretzel manufacturers call PA home, producing 80% of the pretzels in the US and helping it earn the title of the Pretzel Belt.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240720-2?refcode=em20240720-2&refcode2=3615_552475_ROda6t&akid=3615%2E552475%2EROda6t)

**Pennsylvania is one of four states to be considered a Commonwealth.** A Commonwealth is a state that formally declares its independence from Great Britain in its constitution. On the State Capitol building is a brass “Commonwealth” statue.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240720-2?refcode=em20240720-2&refcode2=3615_552475_ROda6t&akid=3615%2E552475%2EROda6t)
While there may be a great divide between Philadelphia Eagles fans and Pittsburgh Steelers fans now — **in one season in 1943 the two teams merged to form the Steagles.** This was the result of World War II, as many players were drafted into service.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240720-2?refcode=em20240720-2&refcode2=3615_552475_ROda6t&akid=3615%2E552475%2EROda6t)
Pennsylvania is full of rich history, and this is just scratching the surface. We love Pennsylvania and want it to be the best it can be.
Like Bob Casey always says, we’re striving to make this a Commonwealth in life as well as in name. [**Will you chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can to power our campaign for Pennsylvania today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240720-2?refcode=em20240720-2&refcode2=3615_552475_ROda6t&akid=3615%2E552475%2EROda6t)
Thanks for all you do.
— Team Casey

| | Hi Peter, I wanted to tell you the story behind this picture. When my daughter Helene was little, I volunteered to help in her classroom. I have always believed in the importance of a strong education and wanted to support her public school teachers. I was shocked by what I saw. Republicans in the Arizona legislature had slashed the budget for our public schools, leaving us with some of the lowest teacher salaries and spending per student in the US. Teachers didn’t have the support or resources to keep up, and our kids suffered the consequences. Helene and I stood with the teachers at the #RedforEd protests — but I wanted to do more. **I decided to run for office for the first time because I wanted to be a voice for working families, public school teachers, and kids like Helene. ** I ran in Arizona’s 10th House district, and after winning, I fought to fully fund our public schools and universities, make community college more affordable, and invest in technical education programs. **I’m running for US Congress to take this fight to the federal level. ** Arizona’s teachers still lack the support they need, especially with the new school voucher program redirecting taxpayer dollars away from public schools. My opponent has voted to slash funding for education programs in Congress, and Trump’s MAGA agenda includes gutting the Department of Education if he wins. This is about building a better future for our kids. [**Peter, every vote will make a difference in this race. [ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, we’ve seen
the chilling impact of the far right’s relentless quest to stack the
courts and one thing is clear...we can no longer depend on an independent
judiciary to hold Trump accountable. It's up to all of us.

Bernie Sanders is sounding the alarm, saying if Trump wins, “It will be
the end of democracy.” [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18703?source=email-20240720&t=1011&akid=6384%2E5885482%2EIu1lzD ]Will you stand with Bernie and pledge to do
everything you can to defeat Trump?

Trump bragged last year that he “totally transformed the federal
judiciary.” For once he wasn’t lying. His 234 judicial nominees (including
three Supreme Court justices) are methodically dismantling decades of
legal precedent and decimating the rule of law.

They overturned Roe v. Wade. They ended affirmative action. They stripped
the EPA and other federal agencies of regulatory power. And then they
granted the president absolute immunity while in office.

Just when it was hard to imagine it could get any worse, this week Trump
appointee Judge Aileen Cannon DISMISSED his classified documents case in
Florida. And she lifted the reasoning for her decision DIRECTLY from an
opinion written by Clarence Thomas on a totally unrelated case.

These compromised, far-right judges are shameless in their plan to let
Trump completely off the hook for all the criminal cases he faces. And we
know another Trump term would be much, much worse.

It’s up to all of us to act now to stop the end of American democracy.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18703?source=email-20240720&t=1012&akid=6384%2E5885482%2EIu1lzD ]Add your name: Join Bernie in pledging to DEFEAT Trump and take back
American democracy from compromised right-wing judges.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18703?source=email-20240720&t=1014&akid=6384%2E5885482%2EIu1lzD ][IMG]

Bernie called SCOTUS, “a right-wing, corporate-sponsored Supreme Court
that continues to serve an extremist agenda.”

But Judge Cannon’s decision earlier this week giving Trump a free pass for
illegally hoarding classified documents and obstructing FBI efforts to get
them back makes it clear that our problem is even deeper than the Supreme
Court.

The writing is on the wall: we can no longer rely on an independent
judiciary to protect us from Trump. And if they’re not going to rein him
in, it’s up to all of us to do it.

We must do everything in our power to stop Trump from getting back in
office. Then, we’ll take on the compromised judiciary, standing with Rep.
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez’s articles of impeachment against SCOTUS
justices.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18703?source=email-20240720&t=1015&akid=6384%2E5885482%2EIu1lzD ]Add your name: Join Bernie and AOC in stopping Trump and taking back
our judiciary. It’s time we end the corruption that’s allowing Trump to
act with total impunity.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18703?source=email-20240720&t=1016&akid=6384%2E5885482%2EIu1lzD ][IMG]

Justice Sonia Sotomayor warned us of what could come when she wrote in her
dissent on the Trump immunity case, “The president is now a king above the
law.” The only way to stop Trump from seizing this absolute power is to
keep him FAR from the White House. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18703?source=email-20240720&t=1017&akid=6384%2E5885482%2EIu1lzD ]Will you join Bernie in doing
everything we possibly can to ensure Trump’s defeated in November?

When we organize, we win.

Allies warned of a “new” Trump. That lasted about 15 minutes.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89241048/486639697/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTE0MzcwMGQtYzI0Ni1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1i3ArnI6SZ7sM5-VG5_RE5qG8Q6ynNOHUnD2Gpex9P8=&emci=2d266007-c246-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9143700d-c246-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Ahead of Trump’s Republican National Convention speech on Thursday, many in the legacy media were pushing the idea of “a new Trump,” a unity candidate changed by the horrific assassination attempt at his rally over the weekend.
The “new Trump” was the lead character in a barrage of media stories full of firsthand accounts from Trump allies claiming Trump had changed into a more reflective, spiritual, and less divisive leader.
**Then Trump’s acceptance speech at the RNC Convention.**
[**We’ll talk more about Trump’s extremely predictable performance at the RNC in a second, but if you’re ready to support COURIER’s factual reporting on the 2024 election, can you chip in $20 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89241049/486639699/-593472309?refcode=20240720-EM-TrumpRNC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTE0MzcwMGQtYzI0Ni1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1i3ArnI6SZ7sM5-VG5_RE5qG8Q6ynNOHUnD2Gpex9P8=)
Here’s just a sample of headlines in the days and hours leading up to Trump’s speech:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89241050/486639701/-593472309?refcode=20240720-EM-TrumpRNC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTE0MzcwMGQtYzI0Ni1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1i3ArnI6SZ7sM5-VG5_RE5qG8Q6ynNOHUnD2Gpex9P8=)
Peter, if you only listened to the first 15 minutes of Trump’s speech, we wouldn’t blame you if you thought these claims had some truth.
But the speech was _way_ longer than 15 minutes. In fact, it was the longest acceptance speech in history and Trump played the divisive hits.
He called the U.S. a fallen nation, he lamented that the 2020 election was stolen from him, that Biden was the worst president in history, and that his felony charges were the result of a corrupt justice system going after him in a witch hunt.
**So much for the new Trump, huh?**
**Here’s the thing, Peter, as much as the media might want to give Trump a heroic redemption arc, after a decade of division, lying, and greivances, we know who Trump is.**
And, at COURIER, we’re not afraid to say that. We will never compromise our journalistic values or the truth just to appeal to “both sides” or get a few more clicks.

Peter, Ahead of Trump’s Republican National Convention speech on Thursday, many in the legacy media were pushing the idea of “a new Trump,” a unity candidate changed by the horrific assassination attempt at his rally over the weekend. The “new Trump” was the lead character in a barrage of media stories full of firsthand accounts from Trump allies claiming Trump had changed into a more reflective, spiritual, and less divisive leader. Then Trump’s acceptance speech at the RNC Convention. = Here’s just a sample of headlines in the days and hours leading up to Trump’s speech: = Peter, if you only listened to the first 15 minutes of Trump’s speech, we wouldn’t blame you if you thought these claims had some truth. But the speech was way longer than 15 minutes. In fact, it was the longest acceptance speech in history and Trump played the divisive hits. He called the U.S. a fallen nation, he lamented that the 2020 election was stolen from him, that Biden was the worst president in history, and that his felony charges were the result of a corrupt justice system going after him in a witch hunt. So much for the new Trump, huh? Here’s the thing, Peter, as much as the media might want to give Trump a heroic redemption arc, after a decade of division, lying, and greivances, we know who Trump is. And, at COURIER, we’re not afraid to say that. This November, Missouri voters will likely be able to vote on a ballot proposition that would restore abortion rights and roll back the extreme restrictions that have been in place since Missouri became the first state to outlaw abortion even in the case of rape or incest almost immediately after Roe was overturned.
Passing this urgent constitutional amendment will provide clarity and relief for millions of people—but only if we do everything we can to elect leaders who will protect reproductive rights and defend the will of the people.
In my own race to flip Senate District 15 from red to blue , the stakes could not be higher: all three of the Republicans running to take me on in November have been endorsed by the anti-choice Missouri Right to Life organization . ---
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=3dcaf1d6de&e=a20d8ad2ed)
| Dear Friend,
We are at a crossroads as a state and nation. One week ago, the assassination attempt on President Trump made that crystal clear. But it made another thing even clearer: when Donald Trump gets knocked down, he gets back up again.
The attack made me sick to my stomach. It brought up memories of my childhood living through the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. It revived emotions from the day President Ronald Reagan was shot. The attack was another reminder to me that there is a price to pay for public service, sometimes the ultimate one.
But in the face of this attack, President Trump showed the strength we need from our leaders. President Trump had a lion moment in American politics. We all saw it happen: President Trump got knocked down, and he got back up again. He did not let fear rule the day or dictate his reaction. In fact, he demanded to retrieve his shoes after the Secret Service knocked them off when protecting him. And then, this week, we saw him unite our nation and accept the Republican nomination for President.
The vitriol and division in our country led to this horrible act of political violence. Just as President Trump stood up and raised his fist moments after he was hit, we must stand together and strong in the face of this dark day. His defiance in the face of a would-be assassin should motivate us all to keep fighting.
Don’t be mistaken: last Saturday is a black mark on the history of our nation. Corey Comperatore, the former fire chief of Buffalo Township, Pennsylvania, lost his life to that evil gunman’s act. He lost his life defending his family from gunfire in a pure, selfless act of heroism. Corey was truly a giant among men on that dark day, and his last moments of bravery will be remembered forever.
The photo of President Trump, blood on his face and his fist raised in the air in front of our flag, will forever be in our history books. It will serve as a reminder that freedom isn’t free, and that strong leaders will not falter in the face of adversity, or worse.
---
| Nancy Dahlstrom

# There is still room for truth.
---
---
We are at a pivotal moment in our campaign, and your support has never been more crucial. Recently, our opponent has spread numerous falsehoods, attempting to undermine our mission with deceit and misinformation. But we remain steadfast in our commitment to truth and integrity. In his recent speech at the Republican National Convention, former President Trump made several baseless claims, from exaggerated crime statistics to misleading economic data. These statements not only distort the truth but also undermine the very foundation of our democracy. It's essential that we counter these falsehoods with facts and a unified front.

"Optimism tends to be based on the notion that there's enough evidence out there to believe things are gonna be better, much more rational, deeply secular, whereas hope looks at the evidence and says, 'It doesn't look good at all. Recently, our opponent has spread numerous falsehoods, attempting to undermine our mission with deceit and misinformation. But we remain steadfast in our commitment to truth and integrity. These statements not only distort the truth but also undermine the very foundation of our democracy. It's essential that we counter these falsehoods with facts and a unified front. | "JOIN THE MOVEMENT" Our candidate has always stood for transparency and honesty. As he eloquently stated, "Hope and optimism are different." "Optimism tends to be based on the notion that there's enough evidence out there to believe things are gonna be better, much more rational, deeply secular, whereas hope looks at the evidence and says, 'It doesn't look good at all. Doesn't look good at all. Gonna go beyond the evidence to create new possibilities based on visions that become contagious to allow people to engage in heroic actions always against the odds, no guarantee whatsoever.' That's hope. I'm a prisoner of hope, though." | "SUPPORT THE MOVEMENT" | | "It becomes more clear every day that both the Republican and Democratic parties are beyond redemption. # [Sign: Demand another judge reopen the classified documents case against Trump >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6a597b79-3f39-4b6f-8b31-f5e6e623b89d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | In a move that has been condemned by legal experts across the spectrum, the classified documents case was just dismissed by Trump-appointed Judge Aileen Cannon, who ignored the actual law and bent over backwards to hand Trump this win. [We need another (unbiased) judge to reopen this case immediately. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbe0e7f47-f775-4136-bed3-754925639809/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) This case was arguably the strongest and most important case against Trump. He stole classified documents and left them lying around Mar-a-Lago, unprotected – putting our national security at risk. He moved documents from place to place, and shared highly sensitive military war plans with unauthorized guests. Trump must face the consequences of these crimes – we need another judge (someone who is NOT in Trump’s back pocket) to reopen this case immediately. He is NOT above the law! President Joe Biden’s reelection bid appeared to be nearing the point of collapse on Thursday, amid a cascade of warnings from the Democratic Party’s top leaders that they have lost confidence in his candidacy.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries and former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi each told Biden in separate meetings over the last week that he should reconsider his reelection run or risk losing and dragging the rest of the party down with him. Schumer was “pretty harsh” in his conversation with Biden, said one senior Hill Democrat briefed on the discussion.

The most common question I've encountered is whether President Joe Biden will drop out of the race. And after much thought, I've decided that I think he should drop out. This was not an easy decision. President Biden has accomplished a lot in the past four years. But there is also reason to believe that Democrats running for Congress will suffer if President Biden stays on the ballot. Democrats have a serious enthusiasm problem right now, and fresh blood could give us new energy. I'm running against Max Miller, one of Donald Trump's closest allies. clean_body: | | Peter, I've joined our Senator Sherrod Brown in calling for President Biden to step down and let someone else run with the Democratic nomination. I know Sherrod, and I trust his judgement 100% Over the past couple of weeks, I've made thousands of calls to constituents. The most common question I've encountered is whether President Joe Biden will drop out of the race. And after much thought, I've decided that I think he should drop out. This was not an easy decision. President Biden has accomplished a lot in the past four years. But there is also reason to believe that Democrats running for Congress will suffer if President Biden stays on the ballot. Democrats have a serious enthusiasm problem right now, and fresh blood could give us new energy. I'm running against Max Miller, one of Donald Trump's closest allies. I know that it takes a lot to beat the far-right. We must do whatever it takes to win in November. We can't sit idly by and let Trump win. Things need to change if we're going to pull of this victory. Sincerely, Matt Diemer Democratic Candidate for Congress OH-7 | Diemer for Congress P.O. * * *
Bitcoin and Blockchain 101
Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is pioneering a new era. He is the first presidential candidate to accept Bitcoin via the Lightning Network–over one year before the Trump campaign did the same.
Mr. Kennedy believes in the importance of reclaiming America's traditional values—the America that almost was and yet may be—while innovating for the future. Utilizing Bitcoin and blockchain technologies wisely is central to this vision.
RFK Jr. proposes putting the entire United States budget on a blockchain, enabling citizens to monitor government expenditures in real-time, promoting accountability and transparency. Blockchain is just one way he intends to end government corruption and corporate capture.
Support a president who honors tradition while embracing innovation to create a more just and prosperous future.

Fellow American,

**"While I am in Congress, no one will take Somalia's sea." - United States Congresswoman Ilhan Omar (MN-05)**
Yes, this is an actual quote from a Representative in the United States Congress. More importantly, this is an actual quote from my opponent, who I plan on sending back to Somalia on November 5th. She does not deserve to represent me or you any longer.

[**Help me buy her plane ticket with a donation to my campaign of any amount.**](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=fb19ff692e1f47a38778825509a2d01f&_e=3jeSLp2mzU7Xmv99HGhg07TZhZFPc1Fsvd3LRgbe7rs8Rt9yk7Ke-YdNaerG03sd9ulS1QxLS_jtkavZ0czGjWcmKy6CDQXg7EGBcniaKh0IfAIFAh2gnoMG-AhwzHPqSPhXA5KjfR5zcEnVOa6Nlt0esIhbQ2zdpnoB6Ue_AMteXMnACYmSb4T1vuWy2M1XABH7NleZoAt6t3FbMLF8mWk2475dm8-NxKoRjeA30JzJ0YegmCv3qsGeiiucSM24-3qBZbN9LZ6pykge8YhobS0dTMbZXIizDEG16ovhIFnAYGiym-Wbz34YiEhbIKpx8x7mFgwLbCVUz4lecLOj3pICpNy50LMcYDjSKB9luQ3JXFYLQxqihqyrnJmu_ggEVQ3ib3g7j3shcZQppSPVrhuNvuLuDxLEEiRinIlpPC3V7mw5uCyOBijJEJLCxlr5)

Ilhan Omar has made it clear time and time again that her allegiance lies with Somalia, Hamas, and other American-hating groups. Meanwhile, she disgraces the halls of Congress in Washington, D.C., every day by aligning herself with the Squad and the most Radical factions of the Radical Left.

**I've had enough, and so have the people of Minnesota-05. It's time to expel her from Congress, and that starts with winning this election on November 5.**

But Ilhan Omar has the backing of the Squad and the Deep State Democrats' millions of dollars. The only way we can win is with a strong, nationwide grassroots Conservative effort.

**That's why I'm setting a goal to collect just 50 donations by midnight tonight. No donation is too small (or large) to make a difference in this race.**

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: The RNC was in our backyard
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
|
Hi Derek, Senator Tammy Baldwin here.
The Republican National Convention just happened right here in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.
Look, it’s no coincidence that Donald Trump and national Republicans chose our home state for their convention.
Wisconsin’s 10 electoral votes were the tipping point in the last two presidential elections. Our state put Joe Biden over the top in 2020 and tipped the presidency to Donald Trump in 2016. **_Both elections were decided by less than 1%._**
With Wisconsin’s 10 electoral votes in play again and the Senate majority up for grabs, national Republicans are going all-in to flip our state red — which is why they flocked to Milwaukee for the GOP’s biggest event of the year.
The convention was exactly what we imagined: they hurled attacks our way, touted Project 2025 and their extreme, out-of-touch agenda, and committed to doing whatever it takes to flip Wisconsin red.
**It’s on us to stop them — but I can’t do it alone.**
**[Now that the RNC has wrapped up, can I count on you to split a donation between Adam Schiff and my campaign to prevent Republicans from flipping Wisconsin red? Destiny is committed to restoring integrity and dignity to the office of the Indiana Attorney General and ensuring that Hoosier politics work for everyone in Indiana.

Want to see Indiana rejoin the nation as a state known for its practicality and respect for all people with an AG who respects the rule of law? Consider chipping in $15, $20, or anything you can. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/indems]

INDems

name: Brianna Mast
subject: It’s time for my husband to tell his story
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MAST FOR CONGRESS
body:
President Trump has personally asked Brian to share his story. Our family is ready for the inevitable attacks.

|
---
Friend,

One knock changed our lives forever.

When I saw the military men standing at the door, my heart sank. I feared the worst: that my husband was dead and our young child would grow up without a father.

On September 19, 2010, my husband Brian Mast was blown up by a bomb while serving our nation overseas in the Army. He lost both legs and a finger, but thanks to the Grace of God and the quick action of his fellow soldiers, he is alive today. Together, we have raised four beautiful children, and I thank God every day he is here with us.

body:
We are winning and my opponents are scared |

| | **Don't Believe the Lies **
* * *
"If you're taking flak, you're over the target."

In the last five days, Mike Kehoe and his allies have started an egregious smear campaign against me with three TV ads, many statewide texts, and even a few mail pieces.

**We are winning.** Our fight for the forgotten men and women of Missouri is resonating and my opponents are afraid.

Here's what you need to know about me:
* I am ranked by the American Conservative Union as the #1 most conservative Missouri senator currently in office with a 95.23% lifetime rating.
* I was the 1st candidate to endorse President Trump and am a Trump delegate _and_ elector.
* I am the only candidate who has promised to deport every illegal alien in MO, while Mike Kehoe calls mass deportation "foolish" and "not practical."
* I have repeatedly voted AGAINST allowing benefits for illegals.
* I am the only candidate who has promised to eliminate personal property tax and passed the largest single-year income tax cut in Missouri History.
* I led the effort to pass a constitutional amendment to ban China from owning our land and get back the land that's already been taken. Meanwhile, Mike Kehoe travelled to China to recruit Chinese workers and voted four times to give them our land.

My record is clear; I have been a champion for you. Mike Kehoe knows he is lying, that's why he won't debate me next week. He’s too chicken to answer for his liberal, democrat record. In the past five days, Kehoe and his swamp allies have spent nearly a million dollars lying about me because I am surging in the polls. No matter how much money Kehoe spends, he is desperate and stagnating like the status quo politician he is.

Keep up the hard work. Together, we the people _**will**_ prevail against The Swamp's money. The reckoning is coming on August 6th.

In liberty,

Bill

Florida is home to the _only_ living barrier reefs in the continental United States. Our coral reefs are part of what makes our state one of the most biodiverse states in the country — **and that's why it’s important to protect them**.
**But last summer, we had a record-breaking heatwave across Florida — and it wiped out one coral reef completely and pushed several others to the brink. There's no easy way to say this, friend: There’s a mass coral bleaching happening throughout the Florida Keys. **
One thing's for sure: We need to take action to address the climate crisis that is impacting our coral reefs, and as a result, Floridians, their lives, and their property. **I'm committed to saving our oceans from these growing threats and protecting our environment — and my track record proves it:**
In Congress, I worked with my colleagues to bring _over $200 million_ to the state for environmental and Everglades preservation, fought to protect our world-class beaches and blue waters, and aimed to safeguard the species that make our state so beautiful.

Unlike my _shellfish_ opponent Rick Scott, who banned the use of the term “climate change” as governor and dismisses it as “nuisance flooding,” **I'm committed to helping Florida build the climate-resilient infrastructure needed to fight climate change. **
**But to enact real policies that protect our coral reefs and oceans, I first need to get a _fin_ up on Rick Scott. And with his approval rate dropping and me catching up in the polls, now is the time to _seas_ this opportunity, friend.**

There's no easy way to say this, friend: There’s a mass coral bleaching happening throughout the Florida Keys. One thing's for sure: We need to take action to address the climate crisis that is impacting our coral reefs, and as a result, Floridians, their lives, and their property. I'm committed to saving our oceans from these growing threats and protecting our environment — and my track record proves it: In Congress, I worked with my colleagues to bring over $200 million to the state for environmental and Everglades preservation, fought to protect our world-class beaches and blue waters, and aimed to safeguard the species that make our state so beautiful. Unlike my shellfish opponent Rick Scott, who banned the use of the term “climate change” as governor and dismisses it as “nuisance flooding,” I'm committed to helping Florida build the climate-resilient infrastructure needed to fight climate change. But to enact real policies that protect our coral reefs and oceans, I first need to get a fin up on Rick Scott. And with his approval rate dropping and me catching up in the polls, now is the time to seas this opportunity, friend. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue. | | | = | | = | | = | | = Florida’s natural beauty and unique environment are one of the many things that make it so special — let's keep it that way. Thank you, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

name: Governor Greg Abbott
subject: Biden’s border crisis has been catastrophic for America.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEXANS FOR GREG ABBOTT
body:
It’s time we restore law and order at the border!
---
| | | | | | | Untitled Document [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ce813f1bc4b54ce4bafb6875efd65742&_e=FSXQoj0G3iisvDlnmPgWHzJkvuI-RAOCSSaR26eHXYrR6LN0KZZ3KSLyI4X8cuE3HEdRJ9QOBoCT7f1b7MnouK9I8-KsMk-8TmtUmOKE-dHMULr2FnWXBo_gZGsSb9oAjY5QTXlCS1GEdHZZk9gjEsWKUIdbjBUr5Uo8agsxo6cluP0cAGlql93YYUV6ii4hbzCLGmrP63qoYkjdpmeKYhty9x2T4el1osul3SEHFkRDozH9PwKFGiletlMQhGhH_vcV4kCAtpB91Ao_bB3EVqq5A4OSKBSxbMjrV0j0e4A8ncTAvPJvDiV7HZyWYm3VpuFIBQMPNnDCP7xT6iUYGX_0CfPU3EPS9iJAaMimurlFUpQFzjUHOTmyDeVHgqy3L2uEo1j6wS-_yxl-sfJYcz5o0CzT_ViY3VsdHTAlYrk%3D)
As Governor of the largest border state, I can tell you America desperately needs a President who will secure our border, Peter.

Four years ago, we had the LOWEST illegal border crossings in forty years. Unfortunately, the day President Joe Biden took office, he deserted his presidential duty to protect our country and keep our borders secure. _The result has been catastrophic. _

Under Joe Biden, illegal immigration has skyrocketed. Over _11 MILLION_ immigrants have crossed our borders illegally.

_**That 's more than the entire population of Michigan.

It's twice the population of Wisconsin.**_

Through his open border policies, Joe Biden has welcomed into our country rapists, murderers, and terrorists into communities across our nation.

Sadly, the price we've paid for these reckless policies has been deadly.

The consequences of Joe Biden's border crisis has taken the lives of thousands of Americans and as a result, destroyed thousands of families across the nation.

To make matters worse, the Biden Administration is fighting tooth and nail to stop Texas and other Republican states from defending our border. **[I'm fed up with the lawsuits, but I have made it clear that Texas will NOT back down from this border fight. Will you join our border fight today? >>](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ce813f1bc4b54ce4bafb6875efd65742&_e=FSXQoj0G3iisvDlnmPgWHzJkvuI-RAOCSSaR26eHXYrR6LN0KZZ3KSLyI4X8cuE3HEdRJ9QOBoCT7f1b7MnouK9I8-KsMk-8TmtUmOKE-dHMULr2FnWXBo_gZGsSb9oAjY5QTXlCS1GEdHZZk9gjEsWKUIdbjBUr5Uo8agsxo6cluP0cAGlql93YYUV6ii4hbzCLGmrP63qoYkjdpmeKYhty9x2T4el1osul3SEHFkRDozH9PwKFGiletlMQhGhHxp1obh_0SzsSWQVHtpZc69cjrsVC5qWsGhR9GpTS83nP8aXZeqafCxvveTQ8zCD8EXRACCl8oOgOpHL6uhhdAhbZkwfDp2-K6fZPtDrvkngZHA2rIzqhcGe-6QYd7rJWwDIz7yjrDosEPFuYWjvtU_R38sQgmvZ29M3WXZ7FeqA%3D)**

Under **Operation Lone Star** - Texas' historic mission to defend our border - I have deployed thousands of National Guard soldiers to the southern border to build hundreds of miles of razor wire and anti-climb barriers to deter and repel illegal crossings.
-> When Joe Biden ordered federal officials to _CUT_ the razor wire, I ordered our National Guard soldiers to _TRIPLE_ it.

-> When Joe Biden took 50 acres of Texas PROPERTY to illegally process up to 5,000 illegal immigrants per day, I directed the National Guard to TAKE BACK our land and wire it shut. **Now, crossings there average less than two per day. **

-> When Joe Biden and his border czar, Kamala Harris, refused to come to Texas to see the border crisis they created, I brought the border to them. Operation Lone Star transports illegal immigrants to Washington, D.C. and sanctuary cities across the country every day to relieve our overwhelmed border communities. **Texas will KEEP transporting migrants until the border is finally secure.**
**[Support Texas holding the line today!>>](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ce813f1bc4b54ce4bafb6875efd65742&_e=FSXQoj0G3iisvDlnmPgWHzJkvuI-RAOCSSaR26eHXYrR6LN0KZZ3KSLyI4X8cuE3HEdRJ9QOBoCT7f1b7MnouK9I8-KsMk-8TmtUmOKE-dHMULr2FnWXBo_gZGsSb9oAjY5QTXlCS1GEdHZZk9gjEsWKUIdbjBUr5Uo8agsxo6cluP0cAGlql93YYUV6ii4hbzCLGmrP63qoYkjdpmeKYhty9x2T4el1osul3SEHFkRDozH9PwKFGiletlMQhGhH2-6IeqxBoTZFqqwAZxEn-QDK4MeP-3zfBel3rsU1jet_Djc7KuXrimLPF2iRGJEu_O1ftqCqOQEgVSEr9aSrjcVS-_3Tm1YNIafLQ4D2EfhZW6eACE6RrasvcrxCESQX51Doshd9GbuovYCPWbJwRDhhRMPwcTfScL4fhJ0XxNA%3D)**
Fortunately, I see hope on the horizon. But _I need your help, Peter!_

Working together, this November we will return a President to the White House who will help Texas ENFORCE border security, FIGHT the Mexican drug cartels, and PUNISH criminal illegal immigrants.

_It 's time to restore law and order at the border.

It's time to rid our streets of the crime and chaos ensuing from reckless policies.

It's time to secure our nation by electing a conservative leader as President of the United States. _

**[If that is something you agree with, I'm asking you today - if you are able - to chip in a donation of $5, $10, or even $100 to play a role in defending our nation's future.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ce813f1bc4b54ce4bafb6875efd65742&_e=FSXQoj0G3iisvDlnmPgWHzJkvuI-RAOCSSaR26eHXYrR6LN0KZZ3KSLyI4X8cuE3HEdRJ9QOBoCT7f1b7MnouK9I8-KsMk-8TmtUmOKE-dHMULr2FnWXBo_gZGsSb9oAjY5QTXlCS1GEdHZZk9gjEsWKUIdbjBUr5Uo8agsxo6cluP0cAGlql93YYUV6ii4hbzCLGmrP63qoYkjdpmeKYhty9x2T4el1osul3SEHFkRDozH9PwKFGiletlMQhGhHHadw4-azcNf-ZeI10wRQo6pkb_we6X3oF26hwPMRhcz0D0dXRkHAzoo9kQ6b7K0hoex46F4aPaXzhvPog_becF9W0fFPO1s8rl_WFUw7zyJyAWYTLN0baNG-1ff95ezFRNIBpSUi0EuZe9dPIZ_5jr4Se80XnTBQfu79Fh3URlI%3D)**

Every dollar no matter the amount makes a big impact.

Thank you in advance for your generous donation.

Greg Abbott
Governor of Texas

clean_body: Trump’s VP pick JD Vance supports policies that would devastate our communities and our loved ones. | | | Hey, Peter — Trump’s VP pick JD Vance has a long list of horrifying beliefs and policies that would devastate our communities and our loved ones. But we know you’re busy, so we narrowed it down to 6. If you have a second right now, check out our quick run-down of what you need to know about JD Vance. As he campaigns to become Vice President of the United States, you should know that JD Vance: Has close ties to the creators of Project 2025, the terrifying extremist plan to reshape the government during a second Trump presidency.1 Owes his political career to big-tech billionaires, despite claiming to be a voice for working people.2 Would be a disaster for women’s rights and reproductive justice — believing that women should stay in violent marriages “for the kids”3 and supporting abortion bans even in the case of rape or incest, saying “two wrongs don’t make a right.”4 Opposes LGBTQ rights, including legal protection from discrimination and gender-affirming health care for transgender youth.5 Supported the illegal attempts to overturn the 2020 election 6, and spread lies to help some of the most violent participants on January 6.7 In a cynical, power-hungry move, has dedicated himself to Donald Trump and the MAGA movement despite once saying how dangerous they are — Vance has called Trump “America’s Hitler,” “a total fraud” who “doesn’t actually care about folks,” “reprehensible,” “noxious,” a “moral disaster,” an “idiot,” and “unfit for our nation’s highest office.”8 We cannot sit back and allow Donald Trump and JD Vance’s policies to become the reality in our country. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , Advocate, July, 16 2024. 2\. , NPR, July 17, 2024. 3\. , Vice , July 25, 2022. 4\. , CBS News , July 18, 2024. 5\. , Washington Blade , July 15, 2024. 6\. , USA Today , July 16, 2024. 7\. , CNN , January 8, 2022. 8\. , Vanity Fair , July 16, 2024. Team: Things here in Florida are seriously heating up with only **one month** to go until the primary.
And after hearing Rick Scott's speech at the Republican National Convention, the facts couldn't be more sobering: **If Donald Trump, J.D. Vance, and Rick Scott win in November, they could unleash their dangerous, extremist agenda on the American people come January.**
**But here's the good news: Rick Scott’s approval rating is tanking, and the latest polls show us catching up to him.** **Now, we have a real opportunity to flip this seat blue.**
Like the rest of Florida, I’m ready to retire my extremist opponent once and for all. **He won by just** **0.12 points** **last time, and that’s because he spent** **$64 MILLION** **of his own money to buy his seat. **
_**Ya no más.** _Rick Scott has done **more harm than good** during his time in power, and he’s proven time and again that he’s in this for his own personal gain, not to better serve the people he’s vowed to protect.
He wrote the plan to **gut Social Security and Medicare, attempted to undermine our elections,** and **tried to raise taxes for working families.**
