| | Fellow American, I've played in lots of double-headers. And that's exactly what you and I have on our hands here. A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=e5528549e0a9457ab6af123c231d0f01&_e=JIfaa4MfO2LNcQG9FdU0xeoug68Ryh4x9vvBxJ5vJcB5zfou4P6Muae6Gn8z2huTaxjYC9axdaFo6oGKSn2HJafEB7tLBdi3U2jRTMkiHurzJxLePOf2wn945TcTDGO7kztY4NLec8yOYHMgYYf8ZrC-7fz1SJmeASLSiQhLPkzVy14CV6HY4e2hs-Qvigp3eDgn5Ipc_gvAX-euUSSfL8mlCv6phEISvSVW1hpC6zBgensClOmDssvKgRxJIttJfpXwibVQWEDauD-RfFNY3S_OaC7fmhuHzIBfQtfNk3u7OwmPz2uTydq-AcnCbzvKb24kzwcliwUgtQm8V80W8vO9PmrjZpJbqhyPrichwUD3ZaKMuam9veecR1iX-LFJCh1V9x17lLt-AeKwdX-vFA%3D%3D)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=e5528549e0a9457ab6af123c231d0f01&_e=JIfaa4MfO2LNcQG9FdU0xeoug68Ryh4x9vvBxJ5vJcB5zfou4P6Muae6Gn8z2huTaxjYC9axdaFo6oGKSn2HJafEB7tLBdi3U2jRTMkiHurzJxLePOf2wn945TcTDGO7kztY4NLec8yOYHMgYYf8ZrC-7fz1SJmeASLSiQhLPkzVy14CV6HY4e2hs-Qvigp3eDgn5Ipc_gvAX-euUSSfL8mlCv6phEISvSVW1hpC6zBgensClOmDssvKgRxJIttJOEc-WhCeZCgUWetewAdy_KH5dFBYafkTVb3n3N4SuMAaytLZdihtWz1ysAWHytdYib9GQ4sXOV5lysZquhYH5ItfIKGxSDCfjWQ_HtRf8gIbFcBsICQ7JWS0m48MnJsI0vpFhfJWJjz1DQO7Qux-kQ%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

subject: An explanation
body:
Since day one, Sarah has been a powerhouse in the Delaware State Senate, proving that small states can do big things.
#
**“Sarah isn’t running to make history. She’s running to make a difference.”**
Our campaign says this often, so we figured we’d explain exactly what that means.
If elected this November, Sarah will become the FIRST out trans member of Congress.
And as **_powerful_** as it will be to finally take trans representation in our government to the next level, she’s _also_ in this race to continue fighting for the issues that are on all of our minds, from affordable health care and housing to the climate crisis and caring for our families.
[**If Sarah sounds like a candidate you’d like to support today, pitch in $5 today. Her primary election is weeks away, so your donation couldn’t come at a better time!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240720-1?refcode=em20240720-1-844&amount=5&refcode2=844_21716_iNRbFk&akid=844%2E21716%2EiNRbFk)
Sarah is an **effective, powerhouse** legislator who can get big things done. And she’s done it by bringing people together. Just look at her record:
✅ **Championing paid medical and family leave.** Sarah led the fight to successfully pass guaranteed **paid leave** to welcome a new child, recover from an illness, or care for a family member.
✅ **Making health care more affordable and available.** Sarah has passed legislation expanding access to **health care** , enhancing **home health services,** and providing **mental health care** to at-risk Delawareans.
✅ **Keeping our families safe from gun violence:** Following Uvalde, Sarah was one of the first elected officials to speak out and demand action in the state. Together with her colleagues, she took on the NRA and fought for the **most significant gun safety package** in state history.
And these are just _some_ of Sarah’s accomplishments.
Now, Sarah is running to take her ability to build bridges and make government work better for families and workers to Capitol Hill. **But with her primary election quickly approaching, we need your help now more than ever!**
[**Can we count on your support to keep the First State blue and help Sarah continue fighting for all of us in Washington?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240720-1?refcode=em20240720-1-844&amount=5&refcode2=844_21716_iNRbFk&akid=844%2E21716%2EiNRbFk)

We appreciate your support,
Team McBride

subject: We need Lucas Kunce in the U.S. Senate!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
Hey Peter, it's Jon Hamm.
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59569?refcode=em20240720-7122&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7122%2E614464%2EE3Nv1c)
Hey Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
**There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.**
So before I ask you to chip in toward my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, please let me explain why no one can afford to sit on the sidelines in this race.
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59569?refcode=em20240720-7122&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7122%2E614464%2EE3Nv1c)**
Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies.
**Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people.**
**[ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59569?refcode=em20240720-7122&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7122%2E614464%2EE3Nv1c)**
Let’s just be clear here: Hawley’s January 6th cowardice isn’t the only reason he’s incapable of representing my home state.
**Since he was elected to office, Josh Hawley hasn’t fought to bring even $0.01 back to our communities — but he’s had plenty of time to make money for himself.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59569?refcode=em20240720-7122&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7122%2E614464%2EE3Nv1c)
While giant corporations strip our state of opportunity and jack up prices, Hawley is only focused on enriching himself. He’s made hundreds of thousands of dollars more than his congressional salary by selling his weird book all about _"Manhood."_
**All this, while he made taxpayers cover the cost of his own lawbreaking.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59569?refcode=em20240720-7122&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7122%2E614464%2EE3Nv1c)
Missouri can’t afford another six years of Hawley in the Senate, Peter, and voters of all stripes seem to agree.
**_Morning Consult_ reported that Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating of any Republican incumbent up for re-election this November.** And even Hawley’s own former mentor, Missouri’s three-term Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth, said supporting Hawley was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_

July 20, 2024
Pundits from both sides of the aisle are analyzing Trump's pick of Ohio Senator J.D. Vance for Vice President. Most postulate that he wants a like-minded acolyte to continue his legacy. Others believe Vance can attract more working-class voters from swing states. Others point out that Vance is a bright guy who will do well in debates.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7feea473-98c5-45ea-8ca6-caa40b53620a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Senator J. D. Vance - VP nominee
There are several calculations when picking a vice-presidential candidate.
One is to appeal to a particular demographic. Trump did this himself when he chose Mike Pence to attract the Religious Right who had significant reason not to trust Trump. After all, Trump's personal lifestyle is not a paragon of traditional values.
Thus, if Trump was trying to increase his appeal, the logical choice would have been Tim Scott to attract more Black voters. Some pundits believe a Nikki Haley pick would attract more suburban women, although if my neck of the woods of Fairfield County, Connecticut is any indication, the Trump choice of a reincarnated Ruth Bader Ginsburg would not help him with this demographic.
Another reason for a VP pick is to carry a specific state. Here the no brainer for Trump was to pick Governor Glen Youngkin of Virginia. This once reliable Republican state has gone Blue since Obama won it in 2008. But polls now show Trump to be leading there and should he win Virginia, he would almost certainly win the presidency.
So why pick Vance? He adds little further appeal.
The real reason is the Vance pick protects Trump himself.
Look at the world from Trump's viewpoint. As soon as he descended the escalator at Trump Tower in 2015, he has been ridiculed and trashed by the media and our ruling class. Even establishment Republicans considered him a joke.
When he shocked the world and won, the media and ruling class were more than outraged. They screeched endlessly. They created the fake Russian hoax causing the loss of the House in 2018. This set up two impeachments. They used COVID as an excuse to legalize ballot harvesting, costing him reelection. Our FBI and CIA lied out of their teeth when they said that Hunter Biden's laptop was Russian disinformation. Polls showed that Trump would have won had this lie not been disseminated.
If Trump would have gone quietly into the sunset, there would have been no problem. But when he chose to run again, the knives came out.
Jean Carroll accused him of sexually assaulting her thirty years ago and a jury convicted Trump without a scintilla of objective evidence. This after a corrupt judge disallowed the jury from hearing that the jacket Carroll claimed to be wearing during the alleged assault was manufactured four years after the date she claimed the incident occurred.
And on it went. There was a $500,000,000 judgement for inflating real estate assets even though the presiding judge admitted no one lost a penny. He is looking at 134-year prison sentence for allegedly having a consensual affair with a porn star and using financial shenanigans to cover it up. A corrupt prosecutor in Georgia filed charges against him for trying to overturn the election. Then she used taxpayer money to hire her lover to take her on lavish vacations and perjured herself by denying it. Yet a corrupt judge allowed her to continue her persecution. And for the first time in American history, our government attacked a political presidential opponent by authorizing armed men to enter Trump's house with orders to use "deadly force if necessary" over a silly argument over classified documents.
But what must have really terrified Trump is a bullet whizzing by his ear. The useless Secret Service is now in damage control blaming local law enforcement. The head of the Secret Service is an incompetent woman Kimberly Cheatle - who was hired only because she is a woman. She stated that no one could be assigned to cover the roof because the roof was sloped! And this DEI (Diversity, Equity and Inclusion) hire refuses to resign. With this woman in charge, Trump cannot even be sure the Secret Service will protect him.
The Secret Service is "investigating" the incident. One year from now, it will still be "an ongoing investigation."
Just because you're paranoid, does not mean they aren't out to get you.
But with the like-minded Vance as his VP, our corrupt ruling class has a huge problem. Put Trump in jail, then deal with Vance. Impeach Trump if he wins, then deal with Vance. Convict Trump of another crime, then deal with Vance.
If our ruling class had not used legal legerdemain to rig the 2020 election, Trump would be finishing his second term, and this would be over. But now we have this mess. And if Trump loses in 2024, there is no evidence that he won't be back in 2028. This guy does not give up.

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****July 20, 2024** **Contact:**[Chris Gustafson](mailto:chris@rogersforsenate.com "chris@rogersforsenate.com") **Sandy Pensler Suspends Senate Campaign, Endorses Mike Rogers**
---
**GRAND RAPIDS, MI** — Today, Republican U.S. Senate candidate Sandy Pensler announced that he is suspending his campaign and endorsing Army veteran, former Congressman, and Trump-endorsed conservative Mike Rogers. Pensler has a long track record of success, helping turn around struggling businesses so they can succeed, starting businesses that have created jobs right here in Michigan, and has been a leader in Republican politics for decades. **Businessman Sandy Pensler:**
“My campaign was always about making America better. The best way to do that is to enact President Trump's policies. To do that, we need control of the Senate, a divisive continued primary effort hurts the chances of that, and that's not OK. So tonight I’m doing the right thing and ceasing my Senate candidacy. It's the right thing. President Trump endorsed Mike Rogers. Tonight, so am I. Mike's going to make a heck of a senator." **U.S. Senate Candidate Mike Rogers:** "This is a tremendous moment of unity and I'm grateful for Sandy Pensler's endorsement and support of our effort to Get America Back on Track. We must be united to defeat the Democrats in November and stop the wasteful spending that's crushing Michigan families and driving up costs for gas and finally secure our wide open southern border." This endorsement follows other high profile endorsements for Mike Rogers, including President Donald J. Trump, former Detroit Police Chief James Craig, Former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo, Michigan Congressional Members Jack Bergman, Lisa McClain, John Moolenaar, and Tim Walberg, former Michigan Congresswoman Candice Miller, NRSC Chairman Steve Daines, and U.S. Senators John Barrasso, Katie Britt, Tom Cotton, Shelley Moore Capito, Joni Ernst, John N. Kennedy, and Tim Scott. Learn more about Mike Rogers and his plan to Get America Back on Track at [RogersForSenate.com](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=cc1a3dcc5763403ba632483ff02456bb&_e=6QABm94WmH_UJZxot5VVQh9o92FOirhdVcdRmpsp8M_uhGXqjZL5FGnr4ExtWZffFRAXciVYtD9P5mOg-crNDxIzECM55K-uEEQDbjgvOfXB11iWRk12z8b3JLcMj6e_MF3M7so5Re2Q47f-4o97vfW9L8VuShq1Dh1IUKPNn1xQfaoFqSo8qejRSBWCaYKvh3IFC7jM3lH3K-mHAvAT1g%3D%3D). **###**
